Sentence (English): I am pleased with this model.
Comments (English): [ Cleans every time ] || ---------------- || HOW I LANDED ON THIS MODEL:-----------------------------------------------A Whirlpool Gold came with our house. I looked up the year that model was discontinued, and that was an impressive longevity without any known service. I assumed KitchenAid, being the higher end tier, would have similar quality and performance. After some research, I landed on this model. I am not disappointed.I compared this to two other major brands, and it was tough. Based on how I use the dishwasher, I felt the unique third rack design might win out slightly in that area. This model added a pop-open drying system, and is supposed to dry better than previous models.A competitor claims to have a built-in softener, but that requires regular cartridge replacements. A quick Google search claimed that to be a failure point for a small percentage. We have soft water. Why add something that I do not need? Another brand features steam and is slightly quieter. While the steam was enticing, I reflected on how well my 14(? ) year old Whirlpool cleaned. Shouldn't this new model be just as good or better? Even with the top rack arm option,and 44db is slightly quieter than my old dishwasher. Visitors frequently complimented that they didn't even realize the old unit was running. SO HOW DOES IT STAND UP? -----------------------------------------There are pros and cons over my old dishwasher. Some of the cons were overcome by making adjustments to how the unit is loaded. Concerns are not about cleaning; it's more about how to pack a full tub. It's a different layout with that third rack.PROS:---------1. In the 3 months of use, I have NOT had any dish come out with residue. (I mostly use "Pro Wash" to sense the amount of residue on my dishes.)2. Quiet! 3. Dries well. The standard dry cycle is usually all I need. Some competitors claim to dry plastics better. The only issue I've had is if an item has a place for water to pool on top of. I don't imagine any dishwasher can compensate for that scenario.4. Learning to use the top rack. (I have even run a couple cycles "Top 2 Racks" only.)CONS:----------1. I had to adjust how I thought about loading a dishwasher. It took me a while to get used to not being able to stack full-sized cups on the left side of my middle rack. (The top rack hangs lower.) However, I now place some cups on the top rack. I will share a little after the cons.2. If the middle rack is not at the highest setting, vertically stacked plates will obstruct the control arm. Even at the highest settings, I have some large serving plates that will still obstruct the arm. (I angle them to fix this issue.) This appears to be a limitation of having a more robust top rack.3. Wash cycles are longer than my older unit. After some research, it appears that all of the major brands have longer cycles, due to energy conservation efforts. This may be a con of all newer dishwashers, but I wanted to address it as something one may notice.4. I almost always push a control panel button when I try to open the door. The buttons are placed where it's natural to grab. This is not an issue, because nothing starts until a final selection is made. It's just something I noticed, and I've seen other reviewers note.FINAL THOUGHTS:---------------------------I waited to share this review, because I questioned whether the larger top rack was worth the perceived space constraints. In my case, I have cups that fit angled on the top rack, so this works in my situation. I am learning to appreciate this dishwasher more than regret it.If you do a lot of baking, it might be worthwhile to measure or take your favorite baking pans into the store. The top rack is great for cups, small containers, spatulas and light silverware loads. It first felt as if things didn't fit properly. I do have some cups that are too long to angle at the top.The left side of the middle rack does not have a high clearance, but I have been able to rearrange the way I load my dishwasher to compensate.The cleaning quality appears to be top notch, 44db is pretty quiet, and it does dry well.I am pleased with this model.

Sentence (English): I am continuing my review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), a 14-place setting built-in model that was the final puzzle piece of our newlywed home appliance graduation.
Comments (English): I am continuing my review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), a 14-place setting built-in model that was the final puzzle piece of our newlywed home appliance graduation. A few days after the refrigerator and Wash Tower arrived, we completed the base cabinet renovation and finally finished the installation. Wow, this is truly a whole new world. They say that with appliances, bigger is better, and I would have regretted it if I had gone with the 12-place setting. First off, true to the Objet Collection style, the design is the epitome of cleanliness. We had it custom-built to match the tone of our kitchen base cabinets, and it fits perfectly, looking just like an existing cabinet without any awkwardness, which has dramatically elevated the overall interior finish. The flat front of the door is uncluttered, and it features a 'Time Lighting' function that displays the remaining time on the floor with light while running; this feature is incredibly intuitive and luxurious. I believe the value of this machine is sufficient just for the fact that it has completely eliminated the time my bride-to-be, who is always tired from commuting to Magok, has to stand in front of the sink. The most satisfying aspects are, of course, its overwhelming collection capacity and the generous 14-place setting capacity. There is more than enough room to fit all the dishes, pots, and pans from dinner in one go. In particular, once I got the hang of stacking dishes like Tetris, I realized it could handle a tower of dishes even for a family of four. Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future. As for noise, perhaps due to the Inverter DD motor, it is quiet enough that I can watch TV in the living room with it running at night without it being noticeable. But above all, the decisive reason I chose this model is the 'Hot Air Drying' function. I saw many reviews complaining that conventional dishwashers rely only on natural drying or automatic door opening, leaving moisture on plastic containers or dishes with rims. However, since this one completely evaporates moisture with hot air just like a washer-dryer, it feels really good to take the dishes out fresh and warm. Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either. Since it has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills is low, so I don't feel guilty running it every day. My wedding is in a few days, and I'm heading straight to Japan for my honeymoon; I think this dishwasher will be treated like a real hero when we get back and start hosting housewarming parties and entertaining guests. If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model. If the price difference between the 12-place setting and the 14-place setting model isn't significant, definitely go for the 14-place setting model with hot air drying. Your quality of life will skyrocket.

Sentence (English): They say that with appliances, bigger is better, and I would have regretted it if I had gone with the 12-place setting.
Comments (English): I am continuing my review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), a 14-place setting built-in model that was the final puzzle piece of our newlywed home appliance graduation. A few days after the refrigerator and Wash Tower arrived, we completed the base cabinet renovation and finally finished the installation. Wow, this is truly a whole new world. They say that with appliances, bigger is better, and I would have regretted it if I had gone with the 12-place setting. First off, true to the Objet Collection style, the design is the epitome of cleanliness. We had it custom-built to match the tone of our kitchen base cabinets, and it fits perfectly, looking just like an existing cabinet without any awkwardness, which has dramatically elevated the overall interior finish. The flat front of the door is uncluttered, and it features a 'Time Lighting' function that displays the remaining time on the floor with light while running; this feature is incredibly intuitive and luxurious. I believe the value of this machine is sufficient just for the fact that it has completely eliminated the time my bride-to-be, who is always tired from commuting to Magok, has to stand in front of the sink. The most satisfying aspects are, of course, its overwhelming collection capacity and the generous 14-place setting capacity. There is more than enough room to fit all the dishes, pots, and pans from dinner in one go. In particular, once I got the hang of stacking dishes like Tetris, I realized it could handle a tower of dishes even for a family of four. Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future. As for noise, perhaps due to the Inverter DD motor, it is quiet enough that I can watch TV in the living room with it running at night without it being noticeable. But above all, the decisive reason I chose this model is the 'Hot Air Drying' function. I saw many reviews complaining that conventional dishwashers rely only on natural drying or automatic door opening, leaving moisture on plastic containers or dishes with rims. However, since this one completely evaporates moisture with hot air just like a washer-dryer, it feels really good to take the dishes out fresh and warm. Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either. Since it has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills is low, so I don't feel guilty running it every day. My wedding is in a few days, and I'm heading straight to Japan for my honeymoon; I think this dishwasher will be treated like a real hero when we get back and start hosting housewarming parties and entertaining guests. If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model. If the price difference between the 12-place setting and the 14-place setting model isn't significant, definitely go for the 14-place setting model with hot air drying. Your quality of life will skyrocket.

Sentence (English): I believe the value of this machine is sufficient just for the fact that it has completely eliminated the time my bride-to-be, who is always tired from commuting to Magok, has to stand in front of the sink.
Comments (English): I am continuing my review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), a 14-place setting built-in model that was the final puzzle piece of our newlywed home appliance graduation. A few days after the refrigerator and Wash Tower arrived, we completed the base cabinet renovation and finally finished the installation. Wow, this is truly a whole new world. They say that with appliances, bigger is better, and I would have regretted it if I had gone with the 12-place setting. First off, true to the Objet Collection style, the design is the epitome of cleanliness. We had it custom-built to match the tone of our kitchen base cabinets, and it fits perfectly, looking just like an existing cabinet without any awkwardness, which has dramatically elevated the overall interior finish. The flat front of the door is uncluttered, and it features a 'Time Lighting' function that displays the remaining time on the floor with light while running; this feature is incredibly intuitive and luxurious. I believe the value of this machine is sufficient just for the fact that it has completely eliminated the time my bride-to-be, who is always tired from commuting to Magok, has to stand in front of the sink. The most satisfying aspects are, of course, its overwhelming collection capacity and the generous 14-place setting capacity. There is more than enough room to fit all the dishes, pots, and pans from dinner in one go. In particular, once I got the hang of stacking dishes like Tetris, I realized it could handle a tower of dishes even for a family of four. Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future. As for noise, perhaps due to the Inverter DD motor, it is quiet enough that I can watch TV in the living room with it running at night without it being noticeable. But above all, the decisive reason I chose this model is the 'Hot Air Drying' function. I saw many reviews complaining that conventional dishwashers rely only on natural drying or automatic door opening, leaving moisture on plastic containers or dishes with rims. However, since this one completely evaporates moisture with hot air just like a washer-dryer, it feels really good to take the dishes out fresh and warm. Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either. Since it has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills is low, so I don't feel guilty running it every day. My wedding is in a few days, and I'm heading straight to Japan for my honeymoon; I think this dishwasher will be treated like a real hero when we get back and start hosting housewarming parties and entertaining guests. If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model. If the price difference between the 12-place setting and the 14-place setting model isn't significant, definitely go for the 14-place setting model with hot air drying. Your quality of life will skyrocket.

Sentence (English): Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future.
Comments (English): I am continuing my review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), a 14-place setting built-in model that was the final puzzle piece of our newlywed home appliance graduation. A few days after the refrigerator and Wash Tower arrived, we completed the base cabinet renovation and finally finished the installation. Wow, this is truly a whole new world. They say that with appliances, bigger is better, and I would have regretted it if I had gone with the 12-place setting. First off, true to the Objet Collection style, the design is the epitome of cleanliness. We had it custom-built to match the tone of our kitchen base cabinets, and it fits perfectly, looking just like an existing cabinet without any awkwardness, which has dramatically elevated the overall interior finish. The flat front of the door is uncluttered, and it features a 'Time Lighting' function that displays the remaining time on the floor with light while running; this feature is incredibly intuitive and luxurious. I believe the value of this machine is sufficient just for the fact that it has completely eliminated the time my bride-to-be, who is always tired from commuting to Magok, has to stand in front of the sink. The most satisfying aspects are, of course, its overwhelming collection capacity and the generous 14-place setting capacity. There is more than enough room to fit all the dishes, pots, and pans from dinner in one go. In particular, once I got the hang of stacking dishes like Tetris, I realized it could handle a tower of dishes even for a family of four. Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future. As for noise, perhaps due to the Inverter DD motor, it is quiet enough that I can watch TV in the living room with it running at night without it being noticeable. But above all, the decisive reason I chose this model is the 'Hot Air Drying' function. I saw many reviews complaining that conventional dishwashers rely only on natural drying or automatic door opening, leaving moisture on plastic containers or dishes with rims. However, since this one completely evaporates moisture with hot air just like a washer-dryer, it feels really good to take the dishes out fresh and warm. Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either. Since it has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills is low, so I don't feel guilty running it every day. My wedding is in a few days, and I'm heading straight to Japan for my honeymoon; I think this dishwasher will be treated like a real hero when we get back and start hosting housewarming parties and entertaining guests. If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model. If the price difference between the 12-place setting and the 14-place setting model isn't significant, definitely go for the 14-place setting model with hot air drying. Your quality of life will skyrocket.

Sentence (English): Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either.
Comments (English): I am continuing my review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), a 14-place setting built-in model that was the final puzzle piece of our newlywed home appliance graduation. A few days after the refrigerator and Wash Tower arrived, we completed the base cabinet renovation and finally finished the installation. Wow, this is truly a whole new world. They say that with appliances, bigger is better, and I would have regretted it if I had gone with the 12-place setting. First off, true to the Objet Collection style, the design is the epitome of cleanliness. We had it custom-built to match the tone of our kitchen base cabinets, and it fits perfectly, looking just like an existing cabinet without any awkwardness, which has dramatically elevated the overall interior finish. The flat front of the door is uncluttered, and it features a 'Time Lighting' function that displays the remaining time on the floor with light while running; this feature is incredibly intuitive and luxurious. I believe the value of this machine is sufficient just for the fact that it has completely eliminated the time my bride-to-be, who is always tired from commuting to Magok, has to stand in front of the sink. The most satisfying aspects are, of course, its overwhelming collection capacity and the generous 14-place setting capacity. There is more than enough room to fit all the dishes, pots, and pans from dinner in one go. In particular, once I got the hang of stacking dishes like Tetris, I realized it could handle a tower of dishes even for a family of four. Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future. As for noise, perhaps due to the Inverter DD motor, it is quiet enough that I can watch TV in the living room with it running at night without it being noticeable. But above all, the decisive reason I chose this model is the 'Hot Air Drying' function. I saw many reviews complaining that conventional dishwashers rely only on natural drying or automatic door opening, leaving moisture on plastic containers or dishes with rims. However, since this one completely evaporates moisture with hot air just like a washer-dryer, it feels really good to take the dishes out fresh and warm. Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either. Since it has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills is low, so I don't feel guilty running it every day. My wedding is in a few days, and I'm heading straight to Japan for my honeymoon; I think this dishwasher will be treated like a real hero when we get back and start hosting housewarming parties and entertaining guests. If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model. If the price difference between the 12-place setting and the 14-place setting model isn't significant, definitely go for the 14-place setting model with hot air drying. Your quality of life will skyrocket.

Sentence (English): If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model.
Comments (English): I am continuing my review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), a 14-place setting built-in model that was the final puzzle piece of our newlywed home appliance graduation. A few days after the refrigerator and Wash Tower arrived, we completed the base cabinet renovation and finally finished the installation. Wow, this is truly a whole new world. They say that with appliances, bigger is better, and I would have regretted it if I had gone with the 12-place setting. First off, true to the Objet Collection style, the design is the epitome of cleanliness. We had it custom-built to match the tone of our kitchen base cabinets, and it fits perfectly, looking just like an existing cabinet without any awkwardness, which has dramatically elevated the overall interior finish. The flat front of the door is uncluttered, and it features a 'Time Lighting' function that displays the remaining time on the floor with light while running; this feature is incredibly intuitive and luxurious. I believe the value of this machine is sufficient just for the fact that it has completely eliminated the time my bride-to-be, who is always tired from commuting to Magok, has to stand in front of the sink. The most satisfying aspects are, of course, its overwhelming collection capacity and the generous 14-place setting capacity. There is more than enough room to fit all the dishes, pots, and pans from dinner in one go. In particular, once I got the hang of stacking dishes like Tetris, I realized it could handle a tower of dishes even for a family of four. Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future. As for noise, perhaps due to the Inverter DD motor, it is quiet enough that I can watch TV in the living room with it running at night without it being noticeable. But above all, the decisive reason I chose this model is the 'Hot Air Drying' function. I saw many reviews complaining that conventional dishwashers rely only on natural drying or automatic door opening, leaving moisture on plastic containers or dishes with rims. However, since this one completely evaporates moisture with hot air just like a washer-dryer, it feels really good to take the dishes out fresh and warm. Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either. Since it has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills is low, so I don't feel guilty running it every day. My wedding is in a few days, and I'm heading straight to Japan for my honeymoon; I think this dishwasher will be treated like a real hero when we get back and start hosting housewarming parties and entertaining guests. If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model. If the price difference between the 12-place setting and the 14-place setting model isn't significant, definitely go for the 14-place setting model with hot air drying. Your quality of life will skyrocket.

The most satisfying aspects are, of course, its overwhelming collection capacity and the generous 14-place setting capacity. There is more than enough room to fit all the dishes, pots, and pans from dinner in one go. In particular, once I got the hang of stacking dishes like Tetris, I realized it could handle a tower of dishes even for a family of four. Thanks to LG's unique TrueSteam function, hardened sauces and grease stains are removed cleanly without the need for pre-washing, and with a sterilization rate of 99.999%—equivalent to baby bottle sterilization—I feel confident using it with peace of mind even when I have children in the future. As for noise, perhaps due to the Inverter DD motor, it is quiet enough that I can watch TV in the living room with it running at night without it being noticeable. But above all, the decisive reason I chose this model is the 'Hot Air Drying' function. I saw many reviews complaining that conventional dishwashers rely only on natural drying or automatic door opening, leaving moisture on plastic containers or dishes with rims. However, since this one completely evaporates moisture with hot air just like a washer-dryer, it feels really good to take the dishes out fresh and warm. Because the automatic door opening lets all the residual steam escape, there is no need to worry about odors either. Since it has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills is low, so I don't feel guilty running it every day. My wedding is in a few days, and I'm heading straight to Japan for my honeymoon; I think this dishwasher will be treated like a real hero when we get back and start hosting housewarming parties and entertaining guests. If you want to be freed from the hell of dishwashing, and especially if you are a newlywed couple who prioritizes interior design and drying performance, I highly recommend the DUE6BGL1E model. If the price difference between the 12-place setting and the 14-place setting model isn't significant, definitely go for the 14-place setting model with hot air drying. Your quality of life will skyrocket.

" It all sounded great, but like any "green" option, there are trade-offs. In this case, the trade-off is in its ability to dry. It does not. Reading up on the machine, it really needs to have a sheeting agent added to the cycle to allow the water to sheet off of the tub and the dishes so that the pump can run it over to the drain. Easy fix, except that I have very soft water, and adding something like that will contribute to my glassware etching (we already use a small amount of detergent to prevent this from happening). I just hate to towel dry everything before I put it away.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher 2 years ago.
Comments (English): [ Breaks Often! ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher 2 years ago. During the first year the buttons on the front started going haywire. I called GE service and after 6 weeks they sent someone out who was able to fix it. It turns out that water had gotten behind the button panel causing the issue. If you look at the dishwasher, but button panel juts out from the front panel. There's no seal here to prevent water running down the front of the dishwasher from getting into the buttons and breaking them. It happened AGAIN a year later and I had to disassemble the door to dry the inside to get it working again. This time I sealed the button panel with silicone caulk to prevent this issue from happening again. It's ridiculous that a dishwasher that sits in a kitchen can't get wet or it will break. Even a tiny amount of water dripping off your counter top completely breaks the button panel and requires completely disassembling the front door to dry it out again. Then the spray arm got stuck on the heating element at the bottom of the dishwasher. This melted the plastic on the sprayer arm and caused it to not clean the bottom rack correctly. I had to buy a new sprayer arm to replace the broken one so it would clean dishes. Now 2 years later, and my dishwasher will stop mid cycle with an FTD error (failure to drain). This happens intermittently and sometimes will fail and sometimes won't. It's now considered out of warranty. GE has NO service appointments available AT ALL. So they won't come and fix it. I have replaced the drain pump, the pressure sensor and the drain hose myself to no avail. Still getting a failure to drain error every other day mid-cycle. Half the time it works, and half the time it doesn't. At this point, even if I could schedule an appointment with the GE Bodewell technician, I will have spent more money fixing this dishwasher between the two calls and parts than if I had just bought a brand new one. It's insane that a 2 year old appliance has THIS MANY ISSUES! Also a WARNING ON INSTALL. Home Depot will NOT install the dishwasher if it is not directly next to your sink. I had to get someone else to install it because my dishwasher has a corner cabinet between it and the sink. Home Depot did not charge me for the install but it would have been good to know that beforehand so I could have prepared to handle it.

Honestly, at first, I hesitated a lot, wondering if a dishwasher was really necessary. Since we don't usually wash dishes immediately after meals, cups and plates would often pile up in the sink; however, using the dishwasher has significantly reduced that stress. The best thing of all is that the "burden of having to do dishes" has disappeared, rather than the washing itself. It feels like one less chore, and my quality of life has definitely improved. Some of you might be hesitating because of the price, but after using it, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I especially recommend this product to two-person households, newlyweds, and dual-income couples.

Sentence (English): Since we are a family of three, I chose a 6-place setting dishwasher.
Comments (English): Since we are a family of three, I chose a 6-place setting dishwasher. I used to do the dishes once a day, but water would splash all the time and my wrists would hurt. The water pressure in the sink would drop if someone flushed the bathroom, and I couldn't take a hot shower while I was doing dishes. Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. My old 6-place setting dishwasher was starting to lose its cleaning power, and since the Samsung Appreciation Festival happened to coincide with this, I took the plunge and replaced it with a 14-place setting model. To start with the conclusion, I wish I had switched sooner. With the 6-place setting, even a slight increase in dishes required running it twice or adding hand washing, but that stress has disappeared since moving to the 14-place setting. We are a family of three, and my initial worry that "this might be too much" turned out to be unfounded; the ample space actually puts my mind at ease. Since a day's worth of dishes, large pots, and frying pans fit comfortably in one go, we rarely need to run it twice. What I like most is the cup washing function. The top rack features a dedicated space for cups, so even tumblers with narrow openings or wine glasses are securely held in place. In the past, water stains would remain inside the cups or pool when turned upside down, but this model seems to have a well-tuned spray angle, as the inside comes out squeaky clean. If you use a lot of cups at home, this feature alone makes it worth the price. The layout is also clean and uncluttered. The height adjustment for the upper, middle, and lower racks is intuitive, and the layout doesn't get tangled even on days when the amount of dishes fluctuates. The capacity is more than enough for a family of three, so it handles everything comfortably in one go, whether you have guests or use a lot of dishes on a regular basis. I realized that efficiency ultimately comes from this kind of ease. I chose the color after much deliberation, and it looks even better in person. It is a comfortable color that doesn't stand out but calmly sets the overall tone of the kitchen, making the space look much more organized now that it's installed as a built-in unit. It is a color I won't get tired of looking at for a long time. Finally, purchasing it at the discounted price during the Samsung Appreciation Event significantly boosted my satisfaction. Considering the usual price range, it is a product that is difficult to decide on without hesitation, but the timing of the event perfectly coincided with my replacement of the old product, and the discount was so substantial that it greatly eased the burden. I feel great because I think I was lucky to make such a good purchase in many ways. In summary, there is nothing to be disappointed about regarding washing performance, space, or design. From a 6-place setting...

Sentence (English): We were happy until it stopped working 2 weeks shy of its first anniversary.
Comments (English): [ I will never buy Samsung again! ] || ---------------- || We were happy until it stopped working 2 weeks shy of its first anniversary. That's when we had the unpleasant surprise of finding out that Samsung has the worst customer and warranty service we have ever experienced. First, it took almost a week to get a technician in; he came, said he had to order a part, and would come back the following week. On week 2, after waiting all day for the technician, we got a message apologizing and rescheduling for yet another week. At week 3, another technician came, took a look at the dishwasher, and said he could not work on it because he could not move it without removing the flooring in the kitchen, and was surprised the first one didn't warn us about the problem (mind that the flooring was already there when the appliance was installed). He had to come back the next day after we figured out how to move it without removing the floors. Then he came back (3rd visit) only to find out that the part that was ordered had nothing to do with the problem, and that the original complaint—the grinding sound it was making—was not noted anywhere in the service notes or request. That sound means a motor problem, and that motor has to be ordered. That will take us to week 4.So I called Samsung to ask when enough is enough. At this point, we can't keep wasting time waiting for visits that fix nothing. We want a replacement. Behold the Samsung policy: there is no limit on time or visits—as long as a technician keeps ordering parts they don't even have to try to install, all the customer can do is wait without a working appliance. There is no length of time or number of visits where they say, “Well, this customer has been inconvenienced enough by the malfunctioning of my equipment and the incompetence of my service, so let me try to remedy that.” None.I can't tell you how this story ends, since it hasn't ended yet. Going into week 4 now and waiting for the next visit. I don't know if it will be the one. All I know is that it shouldn't be like this, and that I WILL NEVER BUY SAMSUNG AGAIN!

Sentence (English): After comparing various brands to buy a dishwasher, I decided that LG is the way to go for home appliances, so I chose the DIOS Objet Collection 12-place setting built-in model.
Comments (English): [ The kitchen atmosphere has brightened up. Function, design, installation service ] || ---------------- || After comparing various brands to buy a dishwasher, I decided that LG is the way to go for home appliances, so I chose the DIOS Objet Collection 12-place setting built-in model. The matte Nature Beige color gives a soft feel, making the kitchen look much wider and brighter. Since it is a built-in model, it fits seamlessly without protruding, so I am extremely satisfied with the appearance from the start. Above all, I am truly grateful to the technician who installed it. It must have been tricky to install since it is a built-in unit, but he finished the job incredibly meticulously and neatly for over an hour without showing a single frown. Thanks to his careful attention to detail, the lines fall beautifully, looking as if custom-made furniture was installed rather than an appliance. As for the cleaning power, which was my biggest concern, even grease and stuck-on rice come out squeaky clean, like a brand-new book. High-temperature sterilization and drying are perfect, and the noise is quiet enough that I could even leave it running at night while I sleep. I can now have my own personal time instead of doing the dishes, so I am recommending it to everyone around me without hesitation. If you are considering buying one, you absolutely won't regret it!

Sentence (English): I used LG for 9 years, but I recently switched to Miele—specifically the model that attaches to the front of the sink.
Comments (English): I used LG for 9 years, but I recently switched to Miele—specifically the model that attaches to the front of the sink. I haven't used Samsung, so I can't really compare, but the parts seem a bit smoother and more precise, and the cleaning power seems a bit better. This time it's the AutoDos model, and it's really good. However, the plate configuration is more suited for Western-style dishes, so laying spoons and chopsticks flat on the very top shelf is a bit of a hassle. I find it more convenient to just shove them all into a cutlery holder to wash them (I've even seen people buy separate stainless steel holders to put them in). I don't know about durability since I just switched, but I've seen a relative use a Miele dishwasher for nearly 20 years. Oh, and I've seen a lot of reviews saying Miele's after-sales service isn't great. But apparently, that means it doesn't break down that often.

A wrench at the top of the foot turned out to be the better option, but there is limited space to turn it.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher I used previously was a 12-place setting model that was about 10 years old.
Comments (English): The dishwasher I used previously was a 12-place setting model that was about 10 years old. After using it for so long, the cleaning performance wasn't what it used to be, and I was disappointed that water would remain after washing or that moisture didn't drain properly from the inside. In particular, since I had to manually open the door after the wash was finished, moisture would sometimes linger inside if I forgot. The biggest improvements I noticed after switching to the DW80H73Y1UZ model were ease of use and increased space. Switching from a 12-place setting to a 14-place setting definitely made the dishwasher storage space more spacious. It became easier to load not only rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, and cups, but also pots and cooking utensils all at once, making cleanup after family meals much easier. Among the new features I experienced, the AI Custom Wash was particularly satisfying. I no longer had to worry about which course to select based on the condition of the dishes every time; it felt convenient to use because it seemed to automatically adjust the cleaning based on the level of soiling. Having switched from an old dishwasher to a modern model, these automated features definitely felt more convenient. The cleaning performance was also excellent. With my old model, I sometimes had to rinse dishes thoroughly beforehand because rice grains or grease would remain, but with the new product, the dishes feel much cleaner after washing. The burden of hand-washing dishes after meals has definitely decreased. The drying function is also significantly different from the previous model. The new product makes drying much easier as the door opens automatically after washing to allow internal moisture to escape. I liked that I no longer had to manually open the door to check the time the wash was finished, as I used to, and I feel less worried about water droplets or odors. While plastic containers may retain a little moisture due to their nature, overall satisfaction with the drying process is definitely better than the previous model. The installation process was also satisfactory. The technician safely removed the old dishwasher and meticulously checked the water supply and drainage connections, as well as the installation location of the new unit. Comments (English): The dishwasher I used previously was a 12-place setting model that was about 10 years old. I no longer had to worry about which course to select based on the condition of the dishes every time; it felt convenient to use because it seemed to automatically adjust the cleaning based on the level of soiling. Having switched from an old dishwasher to a modern model, these automated features definitely felt more convenient. The cleaning performance was also excellent. With my old model, I sometimes had to rinse dishes thoroughly beforehand because rice grains or grease would remain, but with the new product, the dishes feel much cleaner after washing. The burden of hand-washing dishes after meals has definitely decreased. The drying function is also significantly different from the previous model. The new product makes drying much easier as the door opens automatically after washing to allow internal moisture to escape. I liked that I no longer had to manually open the door to check the time the wash was finished, as I used to, and I feel less worried about water droplets or odors. While plastic containers may retain a little moisture due to their nature, overall satisfaction with the drying process is definitely better than the previous model. The installation process was also satisfactory. The technician safely removed the old dishwasher and meticulously checked the water supply and drainage connections, as well as the installation location of the new unit. After installation, they kindly explained the basic usage and precautions, making it easy to understand even the functions I was using for the first time. The work was completed neatly, which gave me confidence. As expected, replacing a product that was over 10 years old has a significant impact.

Sentence (English): The biggest improvements I noticed after switching to the DW80H73Y1UZ model were ease of use and increased space.
Comments (English): The dishwasher I used previously was a 12-place setting model that was about 10 years old. The biggest improvements I noticed after switching to the DW80H73Y1UZ model were ease of use and increased space. Switching from a 12-place setting to a 14-place setting definitely made the dishwasher storage space more spacious. It became easier to load not only rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, and cups, but also pots and cooking utensils all at once, making cleanup after family meals much easier. Among the new features I experienced, the AI Custom Wash was particularly satisfying. I no longer had to worry about which course to select based on the condition of the dishes every time; it felt convenient to use because it seemed to automatically adjust the cleaning based on the level of soiling. Having switched from an old dishwasher to a modern model, these automated features definitely felt more convenient. The cleaning performance was also excellent. With my old model, I sometimes had to rinse dishes thoroughly beforehand because rice grains or grease would remain, but with the new product, the dishes feel much cleaner after washing. The burden of hand-washing dishes after meals has definitely decreased. The drying function is also significantly different from the previous model. The new product makes drying much easier as the door opens automatically after washing to allow internal moisture to escape. I liked that I no longer had to manually open the door to check the time the wash was finished, as I used to, and I feel less worried about water droplets or odors. While plastic containers may retain a little moisture due to their nature, overall satisfaction with the drying process is definitely better than the previous model. The installation process was also satisfactory. The technician safely removed the old dishwasher and meticulously checked the water supply and drainage connections, as well as the installation location of the new unit. After installation, they kindly explained the basic usage and precautions, making it easy to understand even the functions I was using for the first time. The work was completed neatly, which gave me confidence. As expected, replacing a product that was over 10 years old has a significant impact.

After installation, they kindly explained the basic usage and precautions, making it easy to understand even the functions I was using for the first time. The work was completed neatly, which gave me confidence. As expected, replacing a product that was over 10 years old has a significant impact.

Sentence (English): The technician safely removed the old dishwasher and meticulously checked the water supply and drainage connections, as well as the installation location of the new unit.
Comments (English): The dishwasher I used previously was a 12-place setting model that was about 10 years old. After using it for so long, the cleaning performance wasn't what it used to be, and I was disappointed that water would remain after washing or that moisture didn't drain properly from the inside. In particular, since I had to manually open the door after the wash was finished, moisture would sometimes linger inside if I forgot. The biggest improvements I noticed after switching to the DW80H73Y1UZ model were ease of use and increased space. Switching from a 12-place setting to a 14-place setting definitely made the dishwasher storage space more spacious. It became easier to load not only rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, and cups, but also pots and cooking utensils all at once, making cleanup after family meals much easier. Among the new features I experienced, the AI Custom Wash was particularly satisfying. I no longer had to worry about which course to select based on the condition of the dishes every time; it felt convenient to use because it seemed to automatically adjust the cleaning based on the level of soiling. Having switched from an old dishwasher to a modern model, these automated features definitely felt more convenient. The cleaning performance was also excellent. With my old model, I sometimes had to rinse dishes thoroughly beforehand because rice grains or grease would remain, but with the new product, the dishes feel much cleaner after washing. The burden of hand-washing dishes after meals has definitely decreased. The drying function is also significantly different from the previous model. The new product makes drying much easier as the door opens automatically after washing to allow internal moisture to escape. I liked that I no longer had to manually open the door to check the time the wash was finished, as I used to, and I feel less worried about water droplets or odors. While plastic containers may retain a little moisture due to their nature, overall satisfaction with the drying process is definitely better than the previous model. The installation process was also satisfactory. The technician safely removed the old dishwasher and meticulously checked the water supply and drainage connections, as well as the installation location of the new unit. After installation, they kindly explained the basic usage and precautions, making it easy to understand even the functions I was using for the first time. The work was completed neatly, which gave me confidence. As expected, replacing a product that was over 10 years old has a significant impact.

Comments (English): [ No need to dream of 2 dishwashers. This 1 does it! ] || ---------------- || It's been a month or so. The kitchen aid dishwasher has been really nice. I used to think we needed 2 dishwashers, but having a new one that fully functions (compared to a 2021 Samsung that only got the lower rack clean) and all 3 shelves can be filled to capacity really makes a difference. Most days we only need to run one full load. There is a filter with a catch tray that is easy to take out and clean myself so I don't have to ask my husband to take apart the dishwasher to manage it. It's so nice to quickly put reasonably used dishes into the dishwasher and trust they will get clean. And they do! Such a relief. No puzzling, minimal pre rinsing to remove debris, and I can trust the dishes come out clean even with family members loading it. Multiple wash and dry options. I love how quiet it is! It pops open when the cycle is done. Sentence (English): This is a real-world review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is a real-world review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher. As a two-person household, we don't have a huge amount of dishes to wash, but doing them every day was such a hassle that I was debating whether or not to buy one. Just then, my younger sibling bought it for me as a housewarming and birthday gift, and I am using it with complete convenience and satisfaction! We usually gather dishes for about a day to run the wash, or if there are a lot, we gather them for two days and wash them all at once. The interior space is more spacious than I expected, so it fits rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all comfortably—even frying pans fit! Before use, I just rinse the food residue once with water, and the cleaning works perfectly and is spotless. When I first used it, it took me a while because I didn't know how to load the dishes to maximize space. It took time trying out different angles for plates and cup positions, but after using it a few times, I naturally got the hang of it. Now, I stack them neatly by utilizing the empty spaces effectively, just like playing Tetris. Once I got used to it, I am satisfied because it fits much more dishes than I expected. It is so convenient because the door opens automatically to release moisture once the wash is finished, so I don't have to worry about anything. I don't have to open the door manually, and when I check later, most of the moisture is dry, so I just need to tidy up right away! I can start the dishwasher and clean, fold laundry, or do other housework while it finishes. Saving time on washing dishes and reducing strain on my wrists seems to improve my quality of life much more than I expected. I am especially satisfied because the hassle of washing dishes after dinner has disappeared. The design is also clean, as expected from Bespoke, and I like that it doesn't detract from the kitchen decor. I am very satisfied with it.

Sentence (English): We are extremely pleased with the new KitchenAid dishwasher.
Comments (English): We are extremely pleased with the new KitchenAid dishwasher. It washes our dishes very well and they are completely dry when the door automatically opens after it's cycle. The installation of the dishwasher was not satisfactory at all. We had our appliance service technician come back out and totally reinstall the dishwasher. Home Depot's contractor did a very unacceptable job. There was a control box and a wire that was not plugged up to anything which our technician said it was not necessary and he did not know why the contractor exposed this and they should have just thrown it away. Also, the dishwasher was not square with my counter. So it was crooked and that was the first thing I noticed. I tried to call the Home Depot contractor back 3 times and was on hold for about 20 minutes each that day. I was not able to communicate with the contractor to try and find out what the cord was for. I went to Home Depot the next morning and asked them to credit my account for the installation and they credited it very quickly. They mentioned that my wife signed off on the installation, however, they were quick to credit my account which I appreciated. I was very pleased with the customer service at the local Home Depot where I shop. The installation was very poor. I do not associate that experience with Home Depot because I know they are not Home Depot employees but Home Depot should reevaluate who they choose to contract their installation. I will use my own appliance technician to install any other appliances that I need to purchase in the future. Thank you!

Comments (English): Now that I'm over 50, cleaning has become such a hassle, so I bought this dishwasher for myself. I had one before but never used it, and I regret not using it sooner. Back when my kids were growing up, there was a huge amount of dishwashing. There are many 1- and 2-person households these days, so the 12-place setting model is just too big. I even bought it to switch my cooking utensils to stainless steel, but stainless steel is too heavy and requires too much oil, so I haven't ended up using it. As a result, I'm currently just collecting and using regular rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, and cups. I am hesitant to buy the 6-place setting models currently on the market because the interiors aren't made of stainless steel. Please, make a 6-place setting model with a completely stainless steel interior. I have seen some made in China, though. I hope LG makes more products for 1- and 2-person households. Also, the installation technician did a poor job, and that part is about to fall off. I contacted the AS team, but they said they cannot provide repairs because it isn't a mechanical defect. I can't find that technician. LG machines are good, but the after-sales service is really terrible. I used a TV and a dryer, and I had to discard the washing machine. When the service technician came, I didn't get a proper one.

I matched the color to the refrigerator, so it's a bit mismatched with my home's interior, but I'm still happy with it because the color itself is pretty. I highly recommend it, especially for households with babies!

Sentence (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.
Comments (Original): LG 디오스 12인용 식기세척기 한 달 사용후기입니다.이전에 S*매직 식기세척기 6~7년 정도 사용했다가 이사하면서 주방상판보다 키가 큰 제품이었어서 버리고이번에 LG빌트인으로 새로 장만했어요. 기존에 식기세척기 사용했었던 입장에서 그리고 LG매장에 들러서 직접보고 설명들었던 내용들 첨가해서 솔직하게 후기를 써내려가 볼게요.일단 구매하기 전에 고민했던 부분들부터 열거해볼게요.[하부장공사]쿠팡으로 제품 구매하면 LG기사님이 전화를 주십니다.그때 하부장 공사가 필요하다고 말씀하세요. 그럼 오셔서사이즈 재시고 공사비용 말씀해주십니다. 기본 십만원대후반인것 같아요. 주방마다 다 다르고 공사후에 따로 결제하면됩니다. 저희집은 3시간 걸렸는데 집 밖에서 작업하시면서왔다갔다하시느라 정말 힘드셨을텐데 꼼꼼하게 잘 해주셔서 정말 감사드려요.[자동문열림]LG 식기세척기는 기본적으로 자동문열림 기능이 있어요.이 전에 사용했던 제품은 자동문열림 기능이 없어서문여는걸 깜빡하면 건조가 안돼서 너무 불편했었어요.자동문열림은 세척 마지막단계 약 2분 정도 남기고 문이 스르르 열리고, 약 2cm 정도 열리는 것 같지만 그 효과는 정말좋습니다.  [열풍스팀의 유무]저희는 이미 열풍스팀 기능도 없는 제품을 사용했었는데요문만 잘 열어주면 식기가 잘 마르기 때문에 기본기능만있는 이 제품을 선택했어요.자동으로 문이 열리지만 문을 추가로 더 활짝 열수록 건조는 더 잘 되구요, 접시나 그릇을 비스듬하게 담았을 때 더 잘 건조돼요. 그릇을 거꾸로해서 완전히 바닥에 닿게 담게되면 건조가 완전히 되지 않습니다.저는 저녁 식사 후에 식기세척기를 돌리고 자동으로 문이 열린상태로 그대로 두기도 하지만 자기 전에 문을 추가로 더 열어주어요. 그러면 아침에 일어났을 때 건조가잘 되어있어서 식기류를 꺼내서 정리합니다.매장에 가서 설명을 들었을 때 열풍을 하게되면 공기의순환이 이루어져서 기계 안쪽에 필터가 들어가게 돼요.그러면 그 필터도 관리해 주어야 한다고해서 더더욱열풍 제품을 선택하지 않았던 것 같아요.[식기세척기 크기]빌트인 식기세척기는 사이즈가 모두 동일합니다.12인용이나 14인용의 차이는 세척기 안쪽에넣을 수 있는 식기류의 양 차이라고 해요. 저는 열풍스팀 기능을 선택하지 않았고 12인용이면접시 넣는 틈새가 더 여유 있어서 마음에 들었어요.[색상]색상이 베이지 색상인데요, 저희집은 상부장은베이지계열이고 하부장은 밤색이어서 과연 베이지색상이잘 어울어질까 고민했어요. 하지만 색상이 눈에 들어오는건구매할때와 처음 며칠인 것 같아요. 그 뒤에는 크게신경쓰이지 않는 것 같아요. 그렇더라도 밤색과 잘 어울어지고 집에 베이지나 흰색 주방기구가 있으면잘어울려요. 저는 만족합니다.[한 달 사용후기]저는 낮시간에 소소하게 나오는 식기류는 설거지통에담아서 불려놓구요 저녁에 한 번 돌리고 있어요. 적은양을 굳이 돌리는게 싫어요. 생각보다 오래 걸리니까요.저는 보통 한시간짜리 코스로 돌려요. 힘찬 물소리를들으면 애벌이 잘 된 식기류는 세척이 잘 될 수 밖에없는 것 같습니다. 하지만 애벌을 잘 해주는게 중요해요.특히 늘러붙은 치즈나 딱딱한 것들은 잘 제거가 안돼요.저희는 유리제품에 얼룩이 없어서 소금은 사용하지않고 있어요. 소금량이 부족하다고 알람은 계속 뜨지만신경 안쓰고 있습니다. LG고객센터에 문의했는데 소금사용 안해도 된다고 해요. 그리고 어린이가 있는 집은린스 사용 안하는게 더 좋다고 합니다.한 달정도 사용해보니 좋습니다. 기본에 충실한 제품이라고생각합니다. 그리고 쓰다가 안쓰면 식기세척기가 얼마나어깨에 도움이 많이 되는지 아실거에요. 저는 이미 식기세척기를 사용해보았던 사람이지만가전제품을 살 때 이것저것 알아보게되고 고민이많아서 제 리뷰가 도움이 되시라고 길게 적어보았습니다.선택하시는데에 도움이 되기를 바랍니다.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.
