Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.
