Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders.
Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

LG고객센터에 문의했는데 소금사용 안해도 된다고 해요. 그리고 어린이가 있는 집은린스 사용 안하는게 더 좋다고 합니다.한 달정도 사용해보니 좋습니다. 기본에 충실한 제품이라고생각합니다. 그리고 쓰다가 안쓰면 식기세척기가 얼마나어깨에 도움이 많이 되는지 아실거에요. 저는 이미 식기세척기를 사용해보았던 사람이지만가전제품을 살 때 이것저것 알아보게되고 고민이많아서 제 리뷰가 도움이 되시라고 길게 적어보았습니다.선택하시는데에 도움이 되기를 바랍니다.

Comments (English): This is a one-month review of the LG Dios 12-place setting dishwasher. I previously used a S* Magic dishwasher for about 6-7 years, but I threw it away when I moved because it was taller than my kitchen countertop. This time, I purchased a new LG built-in model. I will write an honest review, incorporating my experience as a previous dishwasher user, as well as the details I learned by visiting an LG store to see the product in person and hear explanations. First, let me list the concerns I had before purchasing. [Base Cabinet Renovation]. When you purchase the product via Coupang, an LG technician will call you. You should mention that base cabinet renovation is required. They will then come to measure the dimensions and quote the renovation cost. It seems to be in the high 100,000 won range. It varies depending on the kitchen, and you can pay separately after the renovation is complete. It took 3 hours for my house. They must have been very tired working outside and going back and forth, but they did a meticulous job, so I am truly grateful. [Automatic Door Opening]. LG dishwashers come with an automatic door opening feature by default. The product I used before didn't have an automatic door opening function, so it was very inconvenient because if I forgot to open the door, the dishes wouldn't dry. With the automatic door opening, the door slides open smoothly with about 2 minutes remaining in the final wash cycle. It seems to open only about 2cm, but the effect is really good. [Presence of Hot Air Steam] We had previously used a product without a hot air steam function. However, since dishes dry well as long as the door is opened properly, we chose this product which only has the basic functions. Although the door opens automatically, drying is actually better the more you open it further, and dishes dry better when loaded at an angle. If you load dishes upside down so they touch the bottom completely, they will not dry properly. I run the dishwasher after dinner and sometimes leave it with the door automatically open, but I open the door even more before going to bed. Then, when I wake up in the morning, the dishes are well dried, so I can just take them out and organize them. When I heard the explanation at the store, I learned that if you use the hot air function, the air... Since circulation occurs, a filter is placed inside the machine. I heard that this filter also needs to be maintained, which is why I think I chose the hot air model even more. [Dishwasher Size] Built-in dishwashers all have the same size. They say the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models is the amount of dishes that can be placed inside. I did not select the hot air steam function, and I liked the 12-place model because there is more room for plates. [Color] The color is beige; since the upper cabinets in my house are beige and the lower cabinets are brown, I was worried whether the beige color would match well. However, I think the color only really catches your eye when you buy it and for the first few days. After that, I don't really mind it anymore. Even so, it goes well with brown, and it looks good if you have beige or white kitchenware at home. I am satisfied. [One Month Usage Review] For small dishes generated during the day, I put them in the sink... I soak the dishes in the washing machine and run it once in the evening. I don't like the hassle of washing small loads because it takes longer than expected. I usually run the one-hour cycle. When I hear the powerful sound of the water, I feel like dishes that have been properly pre-washed are bound to be cleaned well. However, pre-washing properly is important. Sticky cheese or hard items are particularly difficult to remove. We don't have any stains on our glassware, so we don't use salt. The alarm keeps popping up saying the salt level is low, but I don't pay attention to it. I inquired with the LG Customer Center, and they said it is not necessary to use salt. They also advised that for households with children, it is better not to use rinse aid. After using it for about a month, I find it good. I think it is a product that stays true to the basics. Also, once you stop using it, you will realize just how much a dishwasher saves your shoulders. Although I have used a dishwasher before, I did a lot of research and had many concerns when buying home appliances, so I wrote this long review hoping it would be helpful to you. I hope it assists you in your decision-making process.

Sentence (English): I was replacing kitchen appliances one by one while moving, and the product I agonized over the most was the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ An appliance that makes you wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. A highly satisfying dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I was replacing kitchen appliances one by one while moving, and the product I agonized over the most was the dishwasher. Honestly, I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but raising two children, I realized the daily volume of dishes is much greater than I thought. Once after breakfast, once after dinner, and again after snacks. Eventually, washing dishes felt like a daily routine, so I made the big decision to purchase the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting. It is a model equipped with a hot air drying function, belonging to Samsung's BESPOKE AI dishwasher lineup. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. The noise level is also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when I ran it after dinner and putting the kids to bed, and I didn't mind it much while watching TV in the living room. In fact, the sound of the washing machine running felt louder. Another great thing was that the kitchen looks much cleaner. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. However, considering it is an appliance used every day, it was a highly satisfying product. I think the satisfaction would be even greater for households with children or families that prepare meals frequently. Overall: After purchasing and using it myself, I felt that dishwashers are no longer a luxury item but closer to an essential household appliance. Dishwashing time has decreased, the kitchen has become cleaner, and time spent with family has increased.

A highly satisfying dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I was replacing kitchen appliances one by one while moving, and the product I agonized over the most was the dishwasher. Honestly, I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but raising two children, I realized the daily volume of dishes is much greater than I thought. Once after breakfast, once after dinner, and again after snacks. Eventually, washing dishes felt like a daily routine, so I made the big decision to purchase the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting. It is a model equipped with a hot air drying function, belonging to Samsung's BESPOKE AI dishwasher lineup. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. The noise level is also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when I ran it after dinner and putting the kids to bed, and I didn't mind it much while watching TV in the living room. In fact, the sound of the washing machine running felt louder. Another great thing was that the kitchen looks much cleaner. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. However, considering it is an appliance used every day, it was a highly satisfying product. I think the satisfaction would be even greater for households with children or families that prepare meals frequently. Overall: After purchasing and using it myself, I felt that dishwashers are no longer a luxury item but closer to an essential household appliance. Dishwashing time has decreased, the kitchen has become cleaner, and time spent with family has increased.

Once after breakfast, once after dinner, and again after snacks. Eventually, washing dishes felt like a daily routine, so I made the big decision to purchase the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting. It is a model equipped with a hot air drying function, belonging to Samsung's BESPOKE AI dishwasher lineup. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. The noise level is also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when I ran it after dinner and putting the kids to bed, and I didn't mind it much while watching TV in the living room. In fact, the sound of the washing machine running felt louder. Another great thing was that the kitchen looks much cleaner. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. However, considering it is an appliance used every day, it was a highly satisfying product. Overall: After purchasing and using it myself, I felt that dishwashers are no longer a luxury item but closer to an essential household appliance. Dishwashing time has decreased, the kitchen has become cleaner, and time spent with family has increased.

A highly satisfying dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I was replacing kitchen appliances one by one while moving, and the product I agonized over the most was the dishwasher. Honestly, I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but raising two children, I realized the daily volume of dishes is much greater than I thought. Once after breakfast, once after dinner, and again after snacks. Eventually, washing dishes felt like a daily routine, so I made the big decision to purchase the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting. It is a model equipped with a hot air drying function, belonging to Samsung's BESPOKE AI dishwasher lineup. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. The noise level is also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when I ran it after dinner and putting the kids to bed, and I didn't mind it much while watching TV in the living room. In fact, the sound of the washing machine running felt louder. Another great thing was that the kitchen looks much cleaner. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. However, considering it is an appliance used every day, it was a highly satisfying product. I think the satisfaction would be even greater for households with children or families that prepare meals frequently. Overall: After purchasing and using it myself, I felt that dishwashers are no longer a luxury item but closer to an essential household appliance. Dishwashing time has decreased, the kitchen has become cleaner, and time spent with family has increased.

The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. A highly satisfying dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I was replacing kitchen appliances one by one while moving, and the product I agonized over the most was the dishwasher. Once after breakfast, once after dinner, and again after snacks. Eventually, washing dishes felt like a daily routine, so I made the big decision to purchase the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting. It is a model equipped with a hot air drying function, belonging to Samsung's BESPOKE AI dishwasher lineup. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. The noise level is also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when I ran it after dinner and putting the kids to bed, and I didn't mind it much while watching TV in the living room. In fact, the sound of the washing machine running felt louder. Another great thing was that the kitchen looks much cleaner. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. However, considering it is an appliance used every day, it was a highly satisfying product. I think the satisfaction would be even greater for households with children or families that prepare meals frequently. Overall: After purchasing and using it myself, I felt that dishwashers are no longer a luxury item but closer to an essential household appliance. Dishwashing time has decreased, the kitchen has become cleaner, and time spent with family has increased.

Honestly, I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but raising two children, I realized the daily volume of dishes is much greater than I thought. Once after breakfast, once after dinner, and again after snacks. Eventually, washing dishes felt like a daily routine, so I made the big decision to purchase the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting. It is a model equipped with a hot air drying function, belonging to Samsung's BESPOKE AI dishwasher lineup. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. The noise level is also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when I ran it after dinner and putting the kids to bed, and I didn't mind it much while watching TV in the living room. In fact, the sound of the washing machine running felt louder. Another great thing was that the kitchen looks much cleaner. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. However, considering it is an appliance used every day, it was a highly satisfying product. I think the satisfaction would be even greater for households with children or families that prepare meals frequently. Overall: After purchasing and using it myself, I felt that dishwashers are no longer a luxury item but closer to an essential household appliance. Dishwashing time has decreased, the kitchen has become cleaner, and time spent with family has increased.

The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. Once after breakfast, once after dinner, and again after snacks. Eventually, washing dishes felt like a daily routine, so I made the big decision to purchase the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-place setting. It is a model equipped with a hot air drying function, belonging to Samsung's BESPOKE AI dishwasher lineup. The first thing I noticed after installation was that the interior space was much larger than I expected. For a family of four, all the dishes, pots, and pans from a day's meals fit in at once, so there was no need to run the cycle multiple times. Even with the kids' plates, water bottles, and snack bowls inside, there was still plenty of room, so I could definitely feel the advantage of the 14-place setting capacity. The cleaning performance was also satisfactory. In particular, greasy side dish bowls and dishes stained with sauces like curry or black bean sauce were cleaned thoroughly. At first, I wondered if I needed to pre-wash them, but simply shaking off food residue before putting them in resulted in most items being cleaned perfectly. Personally, the feature I was most satisfied with was the hot air drying function. The dishwashers I used in the past cleaned well, but water droplets would remain, so I eventually had to wipe them again with a dry cloth. However, with this product, when I took the dishes out after drying, even the cups and plates were quite fluffy, making it convenient to store them immediately. The noise level is also quieter than expected. It wasn't bothersome even when I ran it after dinner and putting the kids to bed, and I didn't mind it much while watching TV in the living room. In fact, the sound of the washing machine running felt louder. Another great thing was that the kitchen looks much cleaner. In the past, just looking at a pile of dishes in the sink was stressful, but now I can simply put them in and run it right after a meal, so the kitchen always feels tidy. Of course, the price isn't cheap, and since it requires built-in installation, there is an initial cost burden. However, considering it is an appliance used every day, it was a highly satisfying product. I think the satisfaction would be even greater for households with children or families that prepare meals frequently. Overall: After purchasing and using it myself, I felt that dishwashers are no longer a luxury item but closer to an essential household appliance. Dishwashing time has decreased, the kitchen has become cleaner, and time spent with family has increased.

Sentence (English): This is an honest review based on my personal experience using the LG DIOS dishwasher for a month.
Comments (English): This is an honest review based on my personal experience using the LG DIOS dishwasher for a month. I hope it helps those considering a purchase. 1. Powerful cleaning performance and Tornado Wash Blades. The most satisfying aspect is, as expected, the cleaning power. Even greasy pork belly grill pans or burnt-on rice are cleaned thoroughly without pre-washing; you can simply put them in and they come out spotless. You can see with your own eyes how the 3D water jets from the 54 Tornado Wash Blades spray out to clean every nook and cranny without any blind spots. 2. 100% True Steam, no more hygiene worries. As a family with a child, I was very concerned about hygiene, but the LG DIOS's '100% True Steam' feature gives me great peace of mind. Since it sterilizes dishes with high-temperature steam without worrying about harmful bacteria, it is to the point where there is no need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer. The distinctive squeaky clean feel and sparkling shine you feel when taking dishes out after washing are something that hand washing can never replicate. 3. Noise and Drying Function (Automatic Door Opening). I was worried about noise since the kitchen and living room are connected, but it is quiet enough that it is not at all bothersome even when running at night while watching TV or sleeping. Also, thanks to the feature where the door automatically opens after washing to release hot steam, there is no musty smell, and drying is very natural and fast. 4. Minimizing Water Stains with Water Softening System. I chose a Dios model equipped with a water softening system, and indeed, white water stains (limestone) that usually remain on glass cups or spoons are almost non-existent. Sentence (English): The dishes finish so cleanly that you can put them directly into the cupboard after washing.
Comments (English): This is an honest review based on my personal experience using the LG DIOS dishwasher for a month. I hope it helps those considering a purchase. 1. Since it sterilizes dishes with high-temperature steam without worrying about harmful bacteria, it is to the point where there is no need to use a separate baby bottle sterilizer. The distinctive squeaky clean feel and sparkling shine you feel when taking dishes out after washing are something that hand washing can never replicate. 3. Noise and Drying Function (Automatic Door Opening). I was worried about noise since the kitchen and living room are connected, but it is quiet enough that it is not at all bothersome even when running at night while watching TV or sleeping. Sentence (English): I regret buying this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Smart is not Smart ] || ---------------- || I regret buying this dishwasher. As usual Smart is not Smart it is just complicated all to often. In the case of this dishwasher, Smart is just dumb.It is not a very well designed app to run the dishwasher. The app coupled with a "safety feature" that causes the dishwasher to go into pause mode after opening while running resulted in a complete cycle reset and a complete waste of energy and time. What are you doing Bosch! Another issue resulted from power going off. All the lights on the dishwasher illuminated and I could not reset and there was nothing stated as to what was happening and how to fix it. In fact, when I went to Bosch's support site assistant it wanted me to call a technician out to fix it. As it turned out, after fiddling with it, I was finally able to get the dishwasher to behave again by pressing and holding reset and start/remote. We have had this dishwasher for 2-3 weeks and previously had a Bosch and loved it. But this dishwasher is over the top complicated and aggravating. I would say keep our lives simple and get a unsmart dishwasher and leave it at that. We just want clean dishes and enjoy life not spending 15-30 minutes troubleshooting something that is supposed to be "Smart" and turning out to be really stupid. I anticipate a big time love hate relationship with dishwasher based on experiences to date.

Sentence (English): I was really satisfied with my previous Samsung 12-place setting dishwasher, but after moving to a rental apartment, the layout made it impossible to install a cabinet, so I had no choice but to sell it.
Comments (English): [ I thought it would be uncomfortable using a small one after using a large one, but it's so good! ] || ---------------- || I was really satisfied with my previous Samsung 12-place setting dishwasher, but after moving to a rental apartment, the layout made it impossible to install a cabinet, so I had no choice but to sell it. Since I had already gotten used to a life without doing the dishes, I couldn't give up the dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I purchased the Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting. Honestly, at first, I thought it would be very inconvenient to downsize from the 12-place setting to a 6-place one. However, the storage is more efficient than I expected, and it fits dishes for a family of four quite well. Especially for a household with two children like ours, running it once right after each meal was enough to meet our needs. I think it's great that we can run the morning dishes immediately without letting them pile up! The most satisfying aspect is, of course, the cleaning power of the Samsung dishwasher. It cleans not only rice grains and soup stains but also water stains inside cups so thoroughly that I actually felt they were cleaner than hand washing. The drying performance was also satisfactory; there was hardly any water left when I took the dishes out. Above all, the fact that it is a countertop model meant there was less hassle with installation, which was a huge advantage. What I liked most was that it can be used even in homes where changing the kitchen layout is difficult, such as in jeonse or monthly rentals. The Bespoke design is also clean, so it doesn't look cramped when placed in the kitchen and blends well with the interior. Having used the 12-place setting model, I think the 6-place setting is more than enough to satisfy families or households with limited kitchen space. The door opens fully without having to pull out the bottom rack.2. The racks (all 3) move in and out very smoothly. I have to retrain my muscle memory for the smoothness of their movement. 3. It is QUIET! The only thing I can hear coming from this unit is the water hitting the inside of it. No mechanical noises at all. It is actually a very relaxing vibe. I knew it had a low decibel rating but it is quieter than I imagined.4. The dishes come out clean. I put some things in that were crusty just to see if it would work… it did. That fact alone saves me time and hassle yelling at my kids to clean the dishes before they go into the dishwasher.5. The drying cycle does add a bit of time but it works. I will say that if you have something in there that will hold water, the drying won't work as well. 6. The dedicated silverware jets are game changers - why don't all dishwashers have this? I have never had a dishwasher that had this and didn't know I needed it but now I can't imagine a dishwasher without it.I have been without a dishwasher for six months because my old unit (NOT a GE Profile) died just after the warranty period. I am very happy with my purchase so far.

Comments (English): [ Good priced dishwasher with the right features ] || ---------------- || It was easy to install. I like that the printproof finish keeps the front looking clean. The control panel is a flat, easy to see and access with a clean layout with a status display showing a countdown timer during it's cleaning cycle of the time left in the cycle. These are features that are improvements over the 16 year dishwasher it replaces. Another thing that is kind of cool is that this dishwasher has built-in wifi that provides remote control, status and notifications, and online diagnostics, etc. The only thing it didn't improve on over my previous dishwasher is it's noise level, which isn't really that loud to me. You can hear the water quietly running, but I've run cycles with the tv near by and I don't find the dishwasher loud enough to distract or interfere with the tv. I looked at a little quieter dishwashers, but they were ~80% more expensive and there were always tradeoffs even with dishwashers more than twice the cost. My only hope with this dishwasher is that it lasts at least as long as my previous dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This 6-person countertop model seems absolutely perfect for two-person households like ours or homes with limited kitchen space.
Comments (English): [ How did we live without a dishwasher? ] || ---------------- || This 6-person countertop model seems absolutely perfect for two-person households like ours or homes with limited kitchen space. What I like most is the automatic door opening function that activates after washing to completely remove internal moisture and odors, leaving everything fresh and clean without any musty smell. The noise level is quiet enough to be drowned out by the TV in the living room, and the clean white design doesn't detract from the kitchen decor, making me happy every time I look at it. I now have the luxury of enjoying a cup of tea with my husband instead of doing the dishes. Hesitating only delays delivery. I highly recommend this to anyone who is still deciding!

Sentence (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!"
Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.
