Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "Big Three Housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and drier than hand washing." Before purchasing, my biggest doubt was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Blades: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains or stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core technology, high-temperature steam, dishes make a squeaky clean sound when the wash is finished. In particular, meat grease is washed away completely, and I am extremely satisfied with hygiene as I can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind, without worrying about germs. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any musty odor." The biggest reason for distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and musty odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, moisture condensing on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty odor caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every morning when I organize the dishes to see them nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-place setting model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-place setting model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and a dedicated holder for knives and scissors makes storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: It fits not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers all at once. Instead of a small model that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Cons). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes heavily seasoned or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed in the washing machine to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you must not wash them at all. Washing Time: Selecting the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (The noise is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night thanks to the night mode.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a "life with evenings" and "time for relaxation." If you gather the dishes and run the wash cycle all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly more burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink with aching backs every night and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Among the "three great housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and fluffier than hand washing." Before purchasing, the part I doubted most was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Wings: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains and stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core high-temperature steam technology, dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound after washing is complete. In particular, meat grease is washed away without leaving a trace, and you can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind without worrying about germs, making it highly satisfying in terms of hygiene. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any fishy odor." The biggest cause of distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and fishy odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, condensation on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty, fishy smell caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every time I wake up in the morning and organize the dishes, which are nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-Person Capacity Model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-person model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and there is a dedicated holder for knives and scissors, making storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: Not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers fit inside all at once. Instead of a small product that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Disadvantages). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes with excessive seasoning or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed inside to prevent filter contamination. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any fishy odor." The biggest cause of distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and fishy odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, condensation on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty, fishy smell caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every time I wake up in the morning and organize the dishes, which are nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-Person Capacity Model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-person model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and there is a dedicated holder for knives and scissors, making storage convenient. If you gather the dishes and run it all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink every night with aching backs and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Thanks to this, condensation on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty, fishy smell caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every time I wake up in the morning and organize the dishes, which are nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-Person Capacity Model). If you gather the dishes and run it all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink every night with aching backs and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink every night with aching backs and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. If you gather the dishes and run it all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink every night with aching backs and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink every night with aching backs and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [Purchased with My Own Money] "Escape the Dishwashing Hell!" An Honest Review of the LG DIOS Dishwasher After 1 Year of Real-World Use. Among the "three great housekeepers" (dryers, robot vacuums, and dishwashers) said to dramatically increase household labor efficiency, I consider the LG DIOS dishwasher to be by far the best. As a dual-income couple, seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after work used to be stressful, but after getting this product, our evenings have completely changed. I will summarize the honest pros and cons I experienced while using it every day for a year. 1. Cleaning Power and Hygiene: "Cleaner and fluffier than hand washing." Before purchasing, the part I doubted most was, "Will it really clean grease stains well?" To start with the conclusion, it is much cleaner than scrubbing with a brush in hot water. Tornado Wash Wings: Thanks to strong water jets sprayed three-dimensionally from the top, middle, and bottom, even hardened rice grains and stubborn grease stains on frying pans are removed without a trace. 100% True Steam & High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to LG's core high-temperature steam technology, dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound after washing is complete. In particular, meat grease is washed away without leaving a trace, and you can sterilize baby tableware and tumblers with peace of mind without worrying about germs, making it highly satisfying in terms of hygiene. 2. Drying Performance: "A perfect finish without any fishy odor." The biggest cause of distrust in dishwashers is the "water stains and fishy odor remaining after drying." This product perfectly solves this problem by having the hot air drying function and automatic door opening function work together organically. When the cycle is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release the hot steam inside. Thanks to this, condensation on plastic food containers dries quickly, and there is absolutely no musty, fishy smell caused by internal humidity. I feel a sense of satisfaction every time I wake up in the morning and organize the dishes, which are nice and dry. 3. Interior Space and Storage (Based on the 14-Person Capacity Model). Even though we are a two-person household, we chose the large-capacity 14-person model, and it was truly the best choice. Smart Shelf System: The height of the upper and lower shelves is freely adjustable, and there is a dedicated holder for knives and scissors, making storage convenient. Advantages of Large Capacity: Not only the rice and soup bowls used throughout the day, but also large pots, frying pans, and even blender containers fit inside all at once. Instead of a small product that only fits small dishes, I unconditionally recommend the "bigger is better" philosophy. 4. Honestly, Areas for Improvement (Disadvantages). Necessity of Pre-washing: Dishes with excessive seasoning or large food scraps must be lightly rinsed with water (pre-washing) before being placed inside to prevent filter contamination. It does not mean you have to leave them completely untouched. Washing Time: If you select the 'Standard + Steam + Hot Air Dry' course, it takes approximately 2 hours. Since the operation time is longer than expected, I usually run it at night after dinner. (Thanks to the night mode, it is quiet enough not to disturb sleep even when running at night.) 5. Overall Review: An appliance that changes the quality of life. The LG Dios dishwasher is more than just a machine that does the dishes for you; it is an appliance that has gifted me a 'life with evenings' and 'time for relaxation.' If you gather the dishes and run it all at once, the water and electricity bills are not significantly burdensome compared to washing by hand. I wholeheartedly recommend this to anyone who wants to reduce the time spent standing at the sink every night with aching backs and enjoy the luxury of having a cup of tea with their family.

Comments (English): [ Shady and incompetent techs. Gaslighting support. ] || ---------------- || I will never order appliances from Costco again. I opted to save myself some time and headache and went with Costco because of the free installation and pickup. At this point, I have installed the unit myself and I'm just paying the premium for pickup of the old unit.The entire experience was a disaster from start to finish. The technician who arrived was friendly enough, but a few minutes into the job, he stopped and claimed the installation could not be completed. He stated that my plumbing needed to be adjusted because there was "no shutoff valve," even showing me a picture of what he was expecting and claiming that removing the old machine would cause a massive leak.He then offered a "solution": if I paid him $150 in cash on the spot, he would go out, buy the part, and install it himself. He offered no other payment alternatives, which immediately felt incredibly shady and suspicious. Because I was actively on a work call at the time, I couldn't stop to inspect the area myself, so I refused his cash offer. He told me I'd have to hire a private plumber and then reschedule Costco to come back out.The next morning, I went to look at the setup myself. Having installed the adjacent sink faucets, I know the plumbing well. To absolutely no surprise, there is a shutoff valve. The hot water line splits into two lines. One for the faucet and one for the dishwasher. Both have clear, functioning shutoff valves.When I called Costco Logistics to report this, the customer support representatives was very reluctant to believe me, completely dismissing me even when I offered to send photos or video evidence. They just scheduled another technician to come out for the following Wednesday, which worked best for my work schedule, but kept saying if the new rep says the same thing, I'd be in the same boat. I admitted I was no plumber but I was under the sink and knew what a shutoff valve was and that I could see it right in front of my face. Frustrated by the gaslighting, I went downstairs, turned the existing shutoff valve, and easily disconnected and removed the old unit myself with zero leaks or issues.Since the old unit was out, I called support back to see if someone could come out earlier than Wednesday to complete the install. Without asking for any additional info, the rep immediately responded with, "Nothing will have changed since you called. There is no new information." I asked him what he meant by that since I hadn't asked for information, and he snapped, "There won't be an earlier time to install." I let him know that my initial request wasn't for an "ASAP" slot, so there actually might be an opening. He finally checked, changed his tune, said someone could come out the next day, and promised I would receive a confirmation text no later than the next morning.The next morning came, and I received no text. I called Costco Logistics for a third time. The new representative told me she saw a note where the previous agent had changed the date, but he had completely failed to actually create a work order. To make matters worse, she then tried to call the installation team to fix it, only to find out they were closed anyway.Fed up with the lies, misinformation, and absolute runaround, I decided to take matters into my own hands. I went downstairs, and 30 minutes later, the new dishwasher was fully installed by myself and working perfectly.

Sentence (English): Our Samsung dishwasher failed in less than a year.
Comments (English): [ Failed pump - Nightmare Warranty Replacement ] || ---------------- || Our Samsung dishwasher failed in less than a year. A technician diagnosed the problem and we entered the warranty process expecting a routine repair.Instead, we spent weeks navigating a confusing chain of repair authorizations, replacement approvals, order changes, transfers between departments, and disconnected calls. At one point we were told the necessary part was unavailable and a replacement was required. Later we learned the repair company had obtained the part and was prepared to complete the repair. The repair was canceled anyway.Samsung ultimately required us to place the warranty replacement order ourselves through their website. The ordering process was difficult, pricing changed repeatedly, and no single representative appeared to own the case from start to finish.The most frustrating part was not the dishwasher failure. Appliances break. The most frustrating part was the amount of time, effort, and persistence required to obtain service on a product that was still under warranty.We expected a warranty claim. Instead, we got a part-time job.

Sentence (English): After much deliberation, I finally took the plunge and installed the 'Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place capacity (Built-in Filter, Custom Cup Wash)' model!
Comments (English): After much deliberation, I finally took the plunge and installed the 'Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Built-in Filter, Custom Cup Wash)' model! To start with the conclusion, I honestly think this is the best purchase I’ve made this year. I have escaped the hell of hand-washing dishes and am experiencing a whole new world every day. Originally, I had a skeptical mindset, thinking, "How clean can a machine really be? Especially for Korean food, rice grains and sauces, you still have to scrub them by hand." However, perhaps because it has "AI" in the name, it detects the level of dirt on the dishes on its own and adjusts the cleaning accordingly. Even rice grains that had hardened in water come out completely extinguished without a trace if I just roughly throw them in without pre-washing. Thanks to the high-temperature direct water spray, the dishes achieve a squeaky clean finish and shine that is absolutely impossible with hand washing. And the real game changer is the fact that it has a large 14-place capacity! At first, I wondered if it was too big for just the two of us, but the saying "the bigger, the better" was absolutely correct. It is so convenient because pots, pans, and even large plates all fit inside at once. In particular, this model features a customized washing function for cups. The water stream reaches deep inside hard-to-reach and tricky-to-clean cups like tumblers, deep glass cups, and wine glasses, leaving them spotlessly clean and clear without a single trace of limescale. With countless coffee and water cups piled up every day, I’m really benefiting from this feature. Furthermore, since it has a built-in filter, it washes dishes with clean water without worrying about microplastics or impurities from the water pipes, so I think households with children or those sensitive to hygiene can use it with peace of mind. The design fits seamlessly into the built-in style; far from ruining the kitchen interior, it looks much cleaner and more luxurious. Once washing is finished, the door opens automatically and performs a hot-air drying process. I can run it at night, and when I wake up in the morning and open the door, the dishes are fluffy and dry, making for a great start to the day. The greatest happiness is being able to relax on the sofa or fully enjoy my own leisure time instead of doing the dishes. It feels like I’ve completely delegated the kitchen closing duties to my aunt. Since this model lacks nothing in terms of performance, capacity, and design, I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone considering buying a dishwasher! Hesitation only delays delivery!

So you can replace it and hope it work another couple of years or just get a new machine.

Sentence (English): A multi-child mom's tearful journey into buying a dishwasher.
Comments (English): A multi-child mom's tearful journey into buying a dishwasher. Seriously, why did I wait so long to buy one? With so many kids, it felt like I was standing in front of the sink all day long—breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The sheer volume of cups, plates, and snack bowls generated daily was enormous. I decided I couldn't take it anymore, so I made the big decision to get one. To start with the conclusion, this isn't just an appliance; it's a "household buddy." Capacity: Kids' plates, cups, and even large pots used for cooking all crammed inside. Washing & Hygiene: Since food goes into the kids' mouths, hygiene was always a concern. The high-temperature sterilization washes everything thoroughly, making me feel much more at ease than hand washing. It's fantastic that it includes a bottle sterilization function and makes sanitizing existing dishes so easy without the hassle. Quality of Life: After putting the dishwasher on, I can do housework and other tasks, giving me more free time. Peace has returned to my mind as I no longer have to sigh while looking at the sink. To all multi-child parents whose wrists are worn out from raising kids. This isn't a luxury item, it's an essential parenting product. Please, buy it as soon as possible and find enlightenment! Installation: A technician arrived within just a few hours of purchase to measure the cabinet, check the installation spot, and leave. It was installed the very next day. I was amazed at how fast everything was, from delivery to installation, with just a flick of my wrist. It's great that it's so easy to use. It's even better because it's a brand-new model from 2026. I highly recommend it without hesitation. You absolutely must buy it. I'm promoting the Samsung dishwasher.

Sentence (English): My mom moved, so I ordered a new one for her.
Comments (English): [ It fits perfectly and neatly. ] || ---------------- || My mom moved, so I ordered a new one for her. The older generation didn't really think a dishwasher was necessary, so she initially didn't want one, but I managed to convince her to get one. I debated between Samsung and LG, but LG is the go-to brand for appliances. Since we already use LG for both our washing machine and dryer, I just decided on the same LG model. I considered choosing the newer model with hot air drying, but my mom said she didn't want to use that feature, so we decided on the previous model. I personally thought having the front panel on top would look cleaner, but my mom said she didn't care about that at all, so we chose this model. There are five of us in the family; usually, only my mom and younger brother are home, but my dad comes over on weekends, and we expect to use it when the pile of dishes grows. First off, the beige color matches the adjacent sink very well, and since I ordered it with a 15cm baseboard underneath, it fits perfectly. At first, it felt like I was forcing it in, but I was told that's how it's supposed to be. Also, they removed the original sink from that spot before leaving. On the first day, the technician ran it for a test run before leaving. I have purchased detergent, but since the move is still about two days away, I haven't actually used it yet. It is nice that the noise isn't as loud as I expected. Since this is my mom's first time using a dishwasher, I don't think she will use it all the time; she will likely use it mainly when a lot of family comes over, and probably won't use it when it's just the two of them. However, I set it up so she can at least use it for drying, which I think will be great. Since people say having a dishwasher makes a huge difference compared to before, I am really looking forward to that. I thought it would be nice for her to watch dramas or videos during the time she usually spends doing the dishes. I am very satisfied.
Comments (Original): [ 깔끔하게 딱맞아요 ] || ---------------- || 엄마가 이사를 하셔서 새로 주문해 드렸어요. 어른들은 식세기를 크게 필요 없어 하셔가지고 안 하신다는 걸 설득해서 하게 됐습니다. 삼성으로 할까 LG로 할까 고민을 했었는데 아무래도 가전은 LG고. 세탁기 건조기가 모두 LG를 쓰고 있어서 그냥 같은 LG 기종으로 정했어요새로 나온 기종 열풍 건조되는 거를 선택할까 했는데 엄마가 그걸 안 쓰고 싶다고 하셔가지고 그냥 이전 모델로 결정을 했고 저는 그 앞에 패널 부분도 위에 있으면 깔끔할 거 같아서 더 좋을 것 같았는데 엄마는 그 부분 전혀 신경 안 쓴다고 하셔가지고 이 모델로 선택했습니다. 가족은 5명인데 평소에는 엄마랑 남동생만 집에 있고 주말에 아빠가 오시고 그때 이제 그릇이 많아지면 사용하게 될 것 같습니다.우선 색상이 베이지색이어서 옆에 싱크대랑 아주 잘 맞고 아래에 걸레받이 15센치 맞춰서 주문한 거라 아주 딱 맞아요. 처음에 뭔가 억지로 쑤셔넣는거 같은 느낌이 들긴 했는데 그냥 원래도 그렇다고는 하더라고요. 그리고 그쪽에 원래 있던 싱크대도 따로 빼주고 가셨어요첫날은 우선 기사님이 임의로 돌려봐 주시고 가셨고 이제 세제를 구매 했는데 이사가 아직 이틀 정도 남아서 실제로 사용해보진 않았어요. 생각보다 소음이 크지 않고 좋네요식세기는 처음 사용해 보는 엄마라. 아마 항상 사용할 것 같진 않고 가족들이 많이 오거나 했을 때 주로 사용하시고 인제 두 분이서 계실 때는 사용 안 하실 것 같더라고요. 근데 그래도 건조용으로라도 쓰라고 해놔서 아주 좋을 것 같습니다.아무래도 식세기가 있으면 이전과는 다르다고 하니까 그걸 꼭 기대해 봅니다. 엄마가 항상 설거지 하던 시간에 드라마라도 보고 동영상이라도 보시는 게 좋지 않을까 싶어서요. 아주 만족합니다

Sentence (English): While living in the U.S., I encountered a dishwasher for the first time, a device that has become commonplace in American culture.
Comments (English): [ The dishwasher is Mom, not Aunt. ] || ---------------- || While living in the U.S., I encountered a dishwasher for the first time, a device that has become commonplace in American culture. The size was so vast that I wondered if I should call it a 20-place setting capacity. While I suppose that’s to be expected since everything in the U.S. is big, American appliances have a strong tendency to prioritize practicality. They are particularly tolerant of noise. Since we lived in an old house, during the summer when the window air conditioner and dishwasher were running, the rhythms of *Gutgeori* and *Jajinmori* drums would reverberate throughout the house. After returning to Korea, I keenly realized how inconvenient life without a dishwasher is, so I intended to buy one immediately, but the cycle of "that money is too much trouble" repeated itself. However, after our child was born, the dishwasher became an essential item. The baby has a bottle washer, so shouldn't there be a dishwasher for Dad and Mom's milk? And we have been using it happily for over two weeks now. The noise really wasn't bothersome. Both my wife and I are extremely sensitive to noise, but even without using night mode, we don't hear any loud drumming. I debated between LG and Samsung, but since our house is practically plastered with Samsung appliances, I installed this dishwasher with a bit of regret, thinking there was no need for it to stand out. However, I was truly satisfied with the cleaning power, noise level, SmartThings ecosystem, and even the installation process. As expected, home appliances are 'Rocket'—I'm slapping my knee in approval once again! Prices fluctuate a bit. If you see an opportunity, buy it with a credit card discount. Coupang might not have the lowest price, but the fact that there is no stress regarding installation or dismantling is a major advantage. Also, I was disappointed that the 'Glide Rail' feature I was considering wasn't available on my unit, but that was just a matter of 'feeling' and had nothing to do with my dishes getting squeaky clean. That's it for my review of a product I bought with my own money. As for a clarification on the title: there are children without aunts, but no child is born into the world without a mother. A dishwasher should be the default, like a mother.
