Sentence (English): I finally got the ultimate kitchen appliance, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting dishwasher.
Comments (English): I finally got the ultimate kitchen appliance, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting dishwasher. Although we are a family of three, I chose the 14-place setting model simply believing the saying "the bigger, the better" when it comes to dishwashers, and I realized why that saying exists within just a few days. 1. The spaciousness of a 14-place setting—this is what true quality of life is. Previously, I used to worry about not having enough space to put pots or pans in the dishwasher, but the 14-place setting is definitely different. Not only large pots, but also oven dishes and long cooking utensils fit in all at once. I no longer have to agonize over stacking the dishes generated daily like playing Tetris, so my dishwashing stress has completely disappeared. 2. Perfectly removing even grease, overwhelming cleaning power. Thanks to the 'True Steam' function, the biggest advantage of LG dishwashers, grease from frying pans after grilling meat and even the sterilization of children's dishes are handled very cleanly. There are almost no water stains left behind, and the dishes are squeaky clean when taken out, giving me great peace of mind regarding hygiene. Above all, the drying performance is outstanding; the fact that the door opens automatically after washing to completely blow away any remaining moisture is truly the best part. 3. Object-like design that blends seamlessly with the kitchen. It looks incredibly luxurious and blends perfectly with my kitchen decor without any sense of incongruity. I am highly satisfied because it feels more like a piece of kitchen furniture than an appliance. The noise level during operation is also much quieter than expected, so it is not at all bothersome even when running late at night. 4. Convenience of ThinQ App connectivity. It is incredibly convenient to be able to check and control it immediately via the smartphone app if I forget to press start or if I am curious about the course settings. Energy consumption is also more efficient than I thought, so I use it every day without any worries. Overall review. The biggest gift of all is having the time to play with my child or enjoy a cozy cup of coffee with my husband instead of doing the dishes. To those considering a dishwasher, I want to tell you that the 14-place setting model is a necessity, not an option. I am truly satisfied with it!
Comments (Original): 드디어 주방 가전의 끝판왕, LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 14인용 식기세척기를 들였습니다. 3인 가족이지만 '식세기는 거거익선(크면 클수록 좋다)'이라는 말만 믿고 14인용을 선택했는데, 왜 그런 말이 나왔는지 며칠 만에 바로 깨달았습니다.1. 14인용의 여유, 이게 진짜 삶의 질이네요이전에는 냄비나 프라이팬이 나오면 식세기에 넣을 공간이 부족해서 고민했는데, 14인용은 확실히 다릅니다. 큰 냄비는 물론이고 오븐 용기, 길쭉한 조리 도구까지 한 번에 다 들어갑니다. 매일 나오는 식기들을 테트리스 하듯 고민하며 쌓지 않아도 되어 설거지 스트레스가 완전히 사라졌어요.2. 기름기까지 완벽하게, 압도적인 세척력LG 식세기의 가장 큰 장점인 '트루스팀' 기능 덕분에 고기 굽고 난 프라이팬 기름기나, 아이 식기 살균까지 아주 깔끔하게 처리됩니다. 물 얼룩도 거의 남지 않고, 꺼냈을 때 식기들이 뽀득뽀득해서 위생적으로 매우 안심이 됩니다. 무엇보다 건조 성능이 뛰어나서, 세척 후 문이 자동으로 열리며 잔여 습기까지 싹 날려주는 점이 정말 최고예요.3. 주방과 하나 되는 오브제 디자인우리 집 주방 인테리어와도 이질감 없이 너무 고급스럽게 잘 어울립니다. 가전이라기보다 주방 가구의 일부 같은 느낌이라 만족도가 높아요. 작동할 때 소음도 생각보다 훨씬 조용해서, 밤늦게 돌려놓아도 전혀 신경 쓰이지 않는 수준입니다.4. ThinQ 앱 연동의 편리함깜빡하고 시작을 안 눌렀거나, 코스 설정이 궁금할 때 스마트폰 앱으로 바로바로 확인하고 조작할 수 있어서 정말 편리합니다. 에너지 소비도 생각보다 효율적이라 매일 부담 없이 사용하고 있습니다.총평설거지하는 시간에 아이와 더 놀아주거나, 남편과 오붓하게 커피 한잔할 여유가 생긴 게 무엇보다 가장 큰 선물입니다. 식기세척기 고민하시는 분들께 14인용은 선택이 아닌 필수라고 말씀드리고 싶네요. 정말 만족하며 사용 중입니다!

Sentence (English): My old Kenmore dishwasher finally died, so that put me in search of a new one.
Comments (English): [ Love this dishwasher - has everything I wanted and more! ] || ---------------- || My old Kenmore dishwasher finally died, so that put me in search of a new one. After checking ratings and reviews of MANY dishwashers of several name brands, going to the store with my own dishes to make sure everything I use on a daily basis would fit in a new dishwasher, and creating comparison charts of my top choices, I finally decided on the GE Profile dishwasher. It dries the dishes perfectly by popping the door open a couple of inches after the wash is complete without taking a long time or using more heating energy (something I didn't really think would happen - but I'm so amazed it does)! I also really wanted folding tines, a FLAT 3rd rack, low noise, and 15-16 place setting capacity. This dishwasher has racks that slide so easily- like butter- I was happily surprised! It also is wifi enabled, has many more settings than I actually need (so far I have only needed the 1 hour wash because everything gets clean in that amount of time). The bottle jets and silverware rack jets are big bonuses that I didn't even know I wanted! I didn't really care about the Microban, but this dishwasher also has that! So far, I am really enjoying this dishwasher, but it has a very quiet chime when it is finished that I can't hear from other rooms, but once I connected it to the app, I can easily see how much time is left and it notifies me when it is finished so I can go pop the door open a little to let steam escape. Negative - it was difficult to hook up.

So far, I am really enjoying this dishwasher, but it has a very quiet chime when it is finished that I can't hear from other rooms, but once I connected it to the app, I can easily see how much time is left and it notifies me when it is finished so I can go pop the door open a little to let steam escape. Sentence (English): I finally got the ultimate kitchen appliance, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting dishwasher.
Comments (English): I finally got the ultimate kitchen appliance, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting dishwasher. Although we are a family of three, I chose the 14-place setting model simply by believing the saying, "The bigger, the better" when it comes to dishwashers, and I realized why that saying exists within just a few days. 1. The spaciousness of the 14-place setting—this is what true quality of life is. Previously, I used to worry about not having enough space to put pots or pans in the dishwasher, but the 14-place setting is definitely different. Not only large pots, but also oven dishes and long cooking utensils fit in all at once. I no longer have to agonize over stacking the dishes generated daily like playing Tetris, so my dishwashing stress has completely disappeared. 2. Perfectly removing even grease, overwhelming cleaning power. Thanks to the 'True Steam' function, the biggest advantage of LG dishwashers, grease from frying pans after grilling meat and even the sterilization of children's dishes are handled very cleanly. Sentence (English): After browsing through the Consumer Reports reviews & recommendations for Dishwashers in 2026, visiting our local Home Depot store (where this model was not present) I ultimately purchased this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Read before purchasing! Product page is misleading. ] || ---------------- || After browsing through the Consumer Reports reviews & recommendations for Dishwashers in 2026, visiting our local Home Depot store (where this model was not present) I ultimately purchased this dishwasher. The positive review from CR was enough for me to order this model, but so many things on the Home Depot site are incorrect that I have to leave a comment for future purchasers: 1) This dishwasher is smaller than a standard size. It's more than an inch shorter and shallower than other comparable models (e.g. LDNPQ44HS). That means less space for dishes, but it also means potential gaps around the machine. The dimensions included for this dishwasher (in the product page) are the size with the expandable/balancing legs extended to their maximum but in the attached photo, those legs are retracted. This left a many-inch gap between the bottom of my countertop and the dishwasher that needed to be filled, even WITH the dishwasher's legs expanded. 2) In the Home Depot checkout, the system suggests you purchase the Required Parts for InstallationDishwasher Parts Kit & Adapter $26.98Dishwasher 110v Cord $12.98Including a note that says, " Required Parts for InstallationThese parts are needed to install your appliance. You may void the manufacturer's warranty if you use different parts."The 'dishwasher parts & adapter' are a new flexible water line and water line adapters. Both were needed but also overpriced and NOT specific to the manufacturer. The 100v Cord is NOT required for this model, as it comes with a cord installed. They're simply insisting you spend $13 for nothing. 3) In the product photos for this model there are multiple that include a 3rd rack for silverware - but that is NOT included in the product. There's just a standard cheap silverware basket that sits in the bottom rack. Regarding the installation of this product (which I did myself), the problems I encountered (size aside) were largely due to poor design. Extendable legs that use a top nut to extend, have that nut blocked by a decorative stainless steel flap that makes it hard to access the mechanism to extend. The side-mounting screw holes (and caps) are not clear mounting points, just openings to the channel. The racks (top and bottom) don't seem to slide well when loaded. The top rack has "3 positions" but the highest position leaves in sufficient space for the lower rack to load tall items (like a serving tray). I have only tested and washed 1 load of dishes thus far, but I absolutely have buyers remorse about my purchase.

Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for one month (installed May 1), and overall there are some features I absolutely love and a few disappointments that keep me from giving it a higher rating.
Comments (English): [ Impressive Capacity, Poor Drying and Early Component Failure ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for one month (installed May 1), and overall there are some features I absolutely love and a few disappointments that keep me from giving it a higher rating.The standout feature is the third rack at the top for silverware and small items. I didn't realize how much I'd appreciate this until I started using it. Being able to remove the silverware basket from the bottom rack frees up a surprising amount of space and makes it much easier to fit larger pots, pans, and serving dishes on the bottom. The adjustable middle rack is another great feature that adds flexibility when loading taller items, and the dishwasher runs very quietly.Unfortunately, there have been a couple of issues. After only one month of use, the top rack cracked during a wash cycle and one of the wheels fell off. The dishwasher is still functional for now, but it's concerning to see a component fail so quickly. It also makes me wonder whether the other wheels will have similar issues over time.My other complaint is drying performance. The dishes consistently come out soaking wet at the end of a normal cycle. There is an “Extra Dry” option that helps significantly, but it adds more than an hour to an already 2.5-hour wash cycle, which feels excessive.Overall, I love the capacity, flexibility, and quiet operation, but the early rack failure and poor drying performance have been disappointing. If those issues weren't present, this would be an easy 5-star appliance.

Sentence (English): As a working newlywed couple, doing the dishes after dinner was a real hassle.
Comments (English): As a working newlywed couple, doing the dishes after dinner was a real hassle. However, we were worried because our kitchen space in our new home wasn't large enough to fit a large 12-place setting model. That was when this slim 6-place setting model became the savior of our kitchen. Let me introduce the charms of this product, which takes up less space with a clean built-in installation while offering powerful performance. 1. Tailored for small kitchens! A slim built-in design that utilizes space very effectively. Usually, when you think of a dishwasher, you imagine a large model that requires significantly cutting into the base cabinets. However, this 6-place setting model features a slim width, so it fits perfectly into even a small kitchen in a newlywed home without being a burden. It can be neatly built into the base (or installed as a countertop depending on the kitchen environment) so it doesn't take up space above the sink, allowing you to utilize the countertop space very effectively. Thanks to the luxurious color palette unique to the Objet Collection, it blends perfectly with your kitchen interior. 2. Peace of mind even when running late at night, with surprisingly quiet low-noise performance. As a working couple, we usually run the dishwasher late at night, so I was worried that the noise might be bothersome when we were relaxing in the living room. However, this product is incredibly quiet. With the door closed, it is so silent that you can barely tell it is running in the living room. Even when operating it late at night or in the early morning, it does not disturb our neighbors or our couple's rest at all, so we use it with peace of mind. 3. That was when this slim 6-place setting model became the savior of our kitchen. Let me introduce the charms of this product, which takes up less space with a clean built-in installation while offering powerful performance. 1. Tailored for small kitchens! A slim built-in design that utilizes space very effectively. Usually, when you think of a dishwasher, you imagine a large model that requires significantly cutting into the base cabinets. However, this 6-place setting model features a slim width, so it fits perfectly into even a small kitchen in a newlywed home without being a burden. It can be neatly built into the base (or installed as a countertop depending on the kitchen environment) so it doesn't take up space above the sink, allowing you to utilize the countertop space very effectively. Thanks to the luxurious color palette unique to the Objet Collection, it blends perfectly with your kitchen interior. 2. Peace of mind even when running late at night, with surprisingly quiet low-noise performance. As a working couple, we usually run the dishwasher late at night, so I was worried that the noise might be bothersome when we were relaxing in the living room. However, this product is incredibly quiet. With the door closed, it is so silent that you can barely tell it is running in the living room. Even when operating it late at night or in the early morning, it does not disturb our neighbors or our couple's rest at all, so we use it with peace of mind. 3. Compact yet efficient storage and powerful cleaning performance. I was worried that the capacity might be insufficient since it is rated for 6 people, but it has a compact interior structure that fits not only the dishes from a single meal for a newlywed couple but also most pots and pans. Powerful water jets are sprayed from both the top and bottom, cleaning even Korean dishes with stuck-on rice grains or greasy frying pans until they are squeaky clean without the need for pre-washing. 4. Giving working newlyweds a break in the evening. Instead of piling dishes in the sink after a meal, we simply throw them all into the dishwasher and press a button to finish the cleaning. Since I can now enjoy tea time or hobbies with my husband in the living room, the time spent on housework has decreased, while the time we spend talking as a couple has increased significantly. I truly realize every day that this is a must-have appliance for newlyweds. Overall Review: I highly recommend this to the following people! Newlyweds who find installing a large dishwasher burdensome due to a small kitchen. Those who want to maintain a minimalist kitchen by efficiently utilizing sink space. Those who want to finish washing dishes quietly without worrying about noise late at night or in the evening. Following the Wash Tower and PuriCare water purifier, this was the best choice to elevate the completeness of our kitchen. If you are looking for a newlywed appliance that combines space efficiency, quietness, and performance, I strongly recommend the LG DUE6BGL1E model!

Comments (English): As a working newlywed couple, doing the dishes after dinner was a real hassle. However, we were worried because our kitchen space in our new home wasn't large enough to fit a large 12-place setting model. That was when this slim 6-place setting model became the savior of our kitchen. Let me introduce the charms of this product, which takes up less space with a clean built-in installation while offering powerful performance. 1. Tailored for small kitchens! A slim built-in design that utilizes space very effectively. Usually, when you think of a dishwasher, you imagine a large model that requires significantly cutting into the base cabinets. However, this 6-place setting model features a slim width, so it fits perfectly into even a small kitchen in a newlywed home without being a burden. It can be neatly built into the base (or installed as a countertop depending on the kitchen environment) so it doesn't take up space above the sink, allowing you to utilize the countertop space very effectively. Thanks to the luxurious color palette unique to the Objet Collection, it blends perfectly with your kitchen interior. 2. Peace of mind even when running late at night, with surprisingly quiet low-noise performance. As a working couple, we usually run the dishwasher late at night, so I was worried that the noise might be bothersome when we were relaxing in the living room. However, this product is incredibly quiet. With the door closed, it is so silent that you can barely tell it is running in the living room. Even when operating it late at night or in the early morning, it does not disturb our neighbors or our couple's rest at all, so we use it with peace of mind. 3. Compact yet efficient storage and powerful cleaning performance. I was worried that the capacity might be insufficient since it is rated for 6 people, but it has a compact interior structure that fits not only the dishes from a single meal for a newlywed couple but also most pots and pans. Powerful water jets are sprayed from both the top and bottom, cleaning even Korean dishes with stuck-on rice grains or greasy frying pans until they are squeaky clean without the need for pre-washing. 4. Giving working newlyweds a break in the evening. Instead of piling dishes in the sink after a meal, we simply throw them all into the dishwasher and press a button to finish the cleaning. Since I can now enjoy tea time or hobbies with my husband in the living room, the time spent on housework has decreased, while the time we spend talking as a couple has increased significantly. I truly realize every day that this is a must-have appliance for newlyweds. Overall Review: I highly recommend this to the following people! Newlyweds who find installing a large dishwasher burdensome due to a small kitchen. Those who want to maintain a minimalist kitchen by efficiently utilizing sink space. Those who want to finish washing dishes quietly without worrying about noise late at night or in the evening. Following the Wash Tower and PuriCare water purifier, this was the best choice to elevate the completeness of our kitchen. If you are looking for a newlywed appliance that combines space efficiency, quietness, and performance, I strongly recommend the LG DUE6BGL1E model!

Sentence (English): As a working newlywed couple, doing the dishes after dinner was a real hassle.
Comments (English): As a working newlywed couple, doing the dishes after dinner was a real hassle. However, we were worried because our kitchen space in our new home wasn't large enough to fit a large 12-place setting model. That was when this slim 6-place setting model became the savior of our kitchen. Let me introduce the charms of this product, which takes up less space with a clean built-in installation while offering powerful performance. 1. Tailored for small kitchens! A slim built-in design that utilizes space very effectively. Usually, when you think of a dishwasher, you imagine a large model that requires significantly cutting into the base cabinets. However, this 6-place setting model features a slim width, so it fits perfectly into even a small kitchen in a newlywed home without being a burden. It can be neatly built into the base (or installed as a countertop depending on the kitchen environment) so it doesn't take up space above the sink, allowing you to utilize the countertop space very effectively. Thanks to the luxurious color palette unique to the Objet Collection, it blends perfectly with your kitchen interior. 2. Peace of mind even when running late at night, with surprisingly quiet low-noise performance. As a working couple, we usually run the dishwasher late at night, so I was worried that the noise might be bothersome when we were relaxing in the living room. However, this product is incredibly quiet. With the door closed, it is so silent that you can barely tell it is running in the living room. Even when operating it late at night or in the early morning, it does not disturb our neighbors or our couple's rest at all, so we use it with peace of mind. 3. Compact yet efficient storage and powerful cleaning performance. I was worried that the capacity might be insufficient since it is rated for 6 people, but it has a compact interior structure that fits not only the dishes from a single meal for a newlywed couple but also most pots and pans. Powerful water jets are sprayed from both the top and bottom, cleaning even Korean dishes with stuck-on rice grains or greasy frying pans until they are squeaky clean without the need for pre-washing. 4. Giving working newlyweds a break in the evening. Instead of piling dishes in the sink after a meal, we simply throw them all into the dishwasher and press a button to finish the cleaning. Since I can now enjoy tea time or hobbies with my husband in the living room, the time spent on housework has decreased, while the time we spend talking as a couple has increased significantly. I truly realize every day that this is a must-have appliance for newlyweds. Overall Review: I highly recommend this to the following people! Newlyweds who find installing a large dishwasher burdensome due to a small kitchen. Those who want to maintain a minimalist kitchen by efficiently utilizing sink space. Those who want to finish washing dishes quietly without worrying about noise late at night or in the evening. Following the Wash Tower and PuriCare water purifier, this was the best choice to elevate the completeness of our kitchen. If you are looking for a newlywed appliance that combines space efficiency, quietness, and performance, I highly recommend the LG DUE6BGL1E model!

Comments (English): As a working newlywed couple, doing the dishes after dinner was a real hassle. Peace of mind even when running late at night, with surprisingly quiet low-noise performance. Compact yet efficient storage and powerful cleaning performance. Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventEntry.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventEntry. Finally welcoming the dishwasher! Freedom from hand washing! [The ultimate new world I acquired while moving]. The appliance I was most looking forward to when moving was the dishwasher! To be honest, until now, I used to live thinking, "There are only two of us, so I'll just quickly wash it by hand." But after moving and installing the built-in unit and using it myself... Wow, this is truly a new world! In just a few days, I am painfully realizing why everyone says dishwashers are love. I never knew that dishwashing freedom would improve my quality of life this much. [Spacious 14-place setting and perfect cleaning power!]. Since we are a two-person household, I was secretly worried that the 14-place setting might be excessively large, but not at all! Because it has a large capacity, it is so convenient to gather all the dishes and cups used throughout the day, as well as the pots, pans, and cooking utensils used for dinner, and run them all at once. Since the space is wide, it is also easy to just toss dishes in without them overlapping! Since the AI automatically recognizes the level of dirt and cleans accordingly, even greasy pans and dishes stained with rice or sauce come out sparkling clean. It is cleaner and drier than hand washing, so I am amazed every time. [The magic that needs no manual, SmartThings]. Although this is my first time using a dishwasher, the controls are intuitive and simple, so it wasn't difficult at all! Best of all, connecting it to the SmartThings app allows me to select the wash cycle, start the cycle, and check the remaining time all from my phone! When the washing is finished, the door slides open automatically to dry, and a completion notification pops up on my phone, which is so convenient. [The magic of 'Cotta White' that brightens up the kitchen]. Since I already matched my refrigerator and kimchi refrigerator in Cotta White, I chose the dishwasher color in Cotta White without hesitation! Because it fits neatly as a built-in unit, there are no parts that stand out, and the entire kitchen feels connected like a set. Thanks to the subtle and luxurious matte texture, the kitchen looks even brighter and more spacious, so I couldn't be happier every time I look at the sink. From design and capacity to AI performance, it is the perfect kitchen helper that lacks nothing!

Sentence (English): I was hesitant about installing a dishwasher because my house wasn't fully renovated, but I'm glad I went ahead with it.
Comments (English): I was hesitant about installing a dishwasher because my house wasn't fully renovated, but I'm glad I went ahead with it. Compared to the model I used about five years ago, I really like the small, customer-centric changes. These include the rinse aid low alert, the drum cleaning notification, the tablet detergent dispenser being placed under the basket, the knife holder, basket height adjustment (which is now easier), and the sturdier ribs on the chopstick holder. Also, when the technician called to confirm before installation, I mentioned my kitchen size, and they connected me with a technician for the cabinet work for a consultation. Thanks to the cabinet work done beforehand, I was able to get the dishwasher installed quickly.

Sentence (English): Delivery and Installation.
Comments (English): Delivery and Installation. Please expect two separate schedules. Before installing the dishwasher, they came first to refurbish the sink. Since it is a built-in design, the dishwasher needs to fit inside the sink cabinet. They came to create the space for the dishwasher. The dishwasher was placed on the bottom right of the sink area, so they removed the existing sink and created a very neat space for it before leaving. The technician was very kind. Next, two technicians came to install the dishwasher. The installation was quick, and afterward, the technician kindly explained how to use it before leaving. Rocket Installation is always friendly and satisfying. Product Design. The color and clean design blend stylishly into any kitchen. I purchased the 12-place setting model, and I am even more satisfied because it holds more than I expected. Performance and Operation. Operation is relatively simple. Thanks to the AI custom wash function, it handles the entire washing process from start to finish; you just need to press the touch buttons a few times for it to take care of everything. Because it uses high-temperature steam, it can clean even burnt-on rice, sauces, and dishes with stubborn grease stains. After thoroughly soaking with high-temperature steam in the Steam Soak course, it cleans powerfully with a strong 4-stage 3D water jet. The 720-degree moving washing blades at the bottom, which rotate simultaneously in both directions, and the washing blades at the top create a 4-stage 3D water jet to powerfully clean not only large surfaces but also every nook and cranny of concave dishes. I use it with peace of mind thanks to the high-temperature direct water and powerful drying that sterilize 99.999% of harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation. It has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, which helps reduce my household's energy burden. You can use it conveniently by installing the Samsung SmartThings app. User Review: I usually run the dishwasher after dinner. It has a night mode, so I can use it quietly at night. Once the dishwasher finishes, the door opens automatically to allow for natural drying. As a result, there is still a lot of moisture remaining on the dishes even after the cycle is complete. I practically leave it open all day long. When I first ran it, brown water came out from under the dishes and cutlery holder, which was quite unpleasant, but it hasn't happened since, so I am using it well now. I use dishwasher-specific detergent, and since stains remain after use, I use a detergent rinse every 20 runs. Using it with the SmartThings app is definitely convenient. They made space for it on the sink and installed it perfectly at a reasonable price; it is a very satisfying appliance. Since getting this dishwasher, my quality of life seems to have improved these days.

Al 맞춤 세척이 있어서 세척의 처음부터 끝까지 알아서 해주니 터치버튼 몇번만 눌러주면 알아서 다해줍니다. 고온 스팀이라 눌어붙은 밥알이나 양념, 기름때가 엉긴 식기도스팀불림 코스의 고온 스팀으로 꼼꼼하게 불린 후 강력한 4단 입체 물살로 강력하게 세척합니다.하단에 양방향 동시 회전하는 720° 무빙 세척 날개와최상단과 상단의 세척날개가 4단 입체 물살을 만들어 넓은 면적은 물론, 오목한 식기의 구석구석 까지 강력하게 세척합니다.플라스틱 변형 걱정 없이 유해세균을 99.999% 살균하는 고온직수와 강력건조로 안심하고 사용중입니다.에너지 소비효율 1등급이라우리집 에너지 부담을 줄여줍니다.삼성스마트씽 앱을 깔아서 편하게 이용할수 있습니다.✔️사용후기주로 저녁을 먹은후에 식세기를 돌리는데 밤에 야간모드도 있어서 저소음으로 이용할수도 있고 식세기가 다돌아가면 저절로 문이 열려서 자연건조를 시켜줍니다그래서 식세기가 다돌아가도 그릇에 물기는 많이 남아있습니다거의 하루종일 항상 열어놓고 생활하고 있습니다처음에 돌렸을때 그릇이나 수저통 밑에서 갈색물이 나와서 영찝찝했는데 그다음부터는 안나와서 지금은 잘 사용중입니다세척기 전용 세제를 이용하고 있고 세척기 사용후에 얼룩같은게 남아서 세재린스를 20번씩 돌릴때마다 같이 사용중입니다스마트씽앱으로 사용하니 확실히 편한것 같습니다합리적인 가격에 싱크대 자리도 만들어주시고 설치도 완벽하게 해주시고 너무 만족스러운 가전제품입니다식세기 이모님 들여서 요즘 삶에 질이 좋아진듯 합니다.

Sentence (English): Since it is a built-in design, the dishwasher needs to fit inside the sink cabinet.
Comments (English): Delivery and Installation. Please expect two separate schedules. Before installing the dishwasher, they came first to refurbish the sink. Since it is a built-in design, the dishwasher needs to fit inside the sink cabinet. They came to create the space for the dishwasher. The dishwasher was placed on the bottom right of the sink area, so they removed the existing sink and created a very neat space for it before leaving. The technician was very kind. Next, two technicians came to install the dishwasher. The installation was quick, and afterward, the technician kindly explained how to use it before leaving. Rocket Installation is always friendly and satisfying. Product Design. The color and clean design blend stylishly into any kitchen. I purchased the 12-place setting model, and I am even more satisfied because it holds more than I expected. Performance and Operation. Operation is relatively simple. Thanks to the AI custom wash function, it handles the entire washing process from start to finish; you just need to press the touch buttons a few times for it to take care of everything. Because it uses high-temperature steam, it can clean even burnt-on rice, sauces, and dishes with stubborn grease stains. After thoroughly soaking with high-temperature steam in the Steam Soak course, it cleans powerfully with a strong 4-stage 3D water jet. The 720-degree moving washing blades at the bottom, which rotate simultaneously in both directions, and the washing blades at the top create a 4-stage 3D water jet to powerfully clean not only large surfaces but also every nook and cranny of concave dishes. I use it with peace of mind thanks to the high-temperature direct water and powerful drying that sterilize 99.999% of harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation. It has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, which helps reduce my household's energy burden. You can use it conveniently by installing the Samsung SmartThings app. User Review: I usually run the dishwasher after dinner. It has a night mode, so I can use it quietly at night. Once the dishwasher finishes, the door opens automatically to allow for natural drying. As a result, there is still a lot of moisture remaining on the dishes even after the cycle is complete. I practically leave it open all day long. When I first ran it, brown water came out from under the dishes and cutlery holder, which was quite unpleasant, but it hasn't happened since, so I am using it well now. I use dishwasher-specific detergent, and since stains remain after use, I use a detergent rinse every 20 runs. Using it with the SmartThings app is definitely convenient. They made space for it on the sink and installed it perfectly at a reasonable price; it is a very satisfying appliance. Since getting this dishwasher, my quality of life seems to have improved these days.

I purchased the 12-place setting model, and I am even more satisfied because it holds more than I expected. Performance and Operation. Operation is relatively simple. Since getting this dishwasher, my quality of life seems to have improved these days.

Since getting this dishwasher, my quality of life seems to have improved these days.

Sentence (English): Operation is relatively simple.
Comments (English): Delivery and Installation. Please expect two separate schedules. Before installing the dishwasher, they came first to refurbish the sink. Since it is a built-in design, the dishwasher needs to fit inside the sink cabinet. They came to create the space for the dishwasher. The dishwasher was placed on the bottom right of the sink area, so they removed the existing sink and created a very neat space for it before leaving. The technician was very kind. Next, two technicians came to install the dishwasher. The installation was quick, and afterward, the technician kindly explained how to use it before leaving. Rocket Installation is always friendly and satisfying. Product Design. The color and clean design blend stylishly into any kitchen. I purchased the 12-place setting model, and I am even more satisfied because it holds more than I expected. Performance and Operation. Operation is relatively simple. Thanks to the AI custom wash function, it handles the entire washing process from start to finish; you just need to press the touch buttons a few times for it to take care of everything. Because it uses high-temperature steam, it can clean even burnt-on rice, sauces, and dishes with stubborn grease stains. After thoroughly soaking with high-temperature steam in the Steam Soak course, it cleans powerfully with a strong 4-stage 3D water jet. The 720-degree moving washing blades at the bottom, which rotate simultaneously in both directions, and the washing blades at the top create a 4-stage 3D water jet to powerfully clean not only large surfaces but also every nook and cranny of concave dishes. I use it with peace of mind thanks to the high-temperature direct water and powerful drying that sterilize 99.999% of harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation. It has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, which helps reduce my household's energy burden. You can use it conveniently by installing the Samsung SmartThings app. User Review: I usually run the dishwasher after dinner. It has a night mode, so I can use it quietly at night. Once the dishwasher finishes, the door opens automatically to allow for natural drying. As a result, there is still a lot of moisture remaining on the dishes even after the cycle is complete. I practically leave it open all day long. When I first ran it, brown water came out from under the dishes and cutlery holder, which was quite unpleasant, but it hasn't happened since, so I am using it well now. I use dishwasher-specific detergent, and since stains remain after use, I use a detergent rinse every 20 runs. Using it with the SmartThings app is definitely convenient. They made space for it on the sink and installed it perfectly at a reasonable price; it is a very satisfying appliance. Since getting this dishwasher, my quality of life seems to have improved these days.

Since getting this dishwasher, my quality of life seems to have improved these days.

Sentence (English): This is a review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Hot Air Dryer Dishwasher (14-place setting).
Comments (English): This is a review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Hot Air Dryer Dishwasher (14-place setting). While moving, I was replacing kitchen appliances one by one and installed the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Hot Air Dryer Dishwasher (14-place setting). Honestly, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but now I am so satisfied with it that I can't live without it. The best part was definitely how much dishwashing time was reduced. Since I just put the dishes in after a meal and press a button, the time I used to spend washing dishes by hand felt like a waste. It was especially convenient to be able to organize the piles of dishes and pots that accumulate after family meals all at once. I also liked that the storage space was ample since it is a 14-place setting. Plates, rice bowls, and soup bowls fit comfortably, as well as frying pans and large pots, so I didn't need to run the cycle multiple times. It was also convenient to be able to organize everything in one go after inviting guests over. I was also satisfied with the hot air drying function. There wasn't much water left after washing, so it was easy to organize immediately, and the surfaces of glass cups and dishes felt like they dried cleanly. I was particularly pleased that plastic containers seemed to dry much better than before. I also found it convenient that it has an AI function that automatically adjusts the wash cycle based on the level of soiling. It was easy to use because it adjusts automatically without requiring complicated settings. The operating noise was quieter than expected, so it wasn't bothersome even when running it in the evening. True to its Bespoke design, I was also satisfied with the clean exterior that blends naturally with the kitchen furniture. Since it is a built-in unit, the space looks much more organized, and the kitchen atmosphere feels much more luxurious. Sentence (English): I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. It is easy to fit plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, pots, and pans all at once, so I think it is a product that is especially well-suited for households with families. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.

Sentence (English): Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.

Sentence (English): The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. It is easy to fit plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, pots, and pans all at once, so I think it is a product that is especially well-suited for households with families. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.

Sentence (English): The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. It is easy to fit plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, pots, and pans all at once, so I think it is a product that is especially well-suited for households with families. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.

Sentence (English): It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. It is easy to fit plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, pots, and pans all at once, so I think it is a product that is especially well-suited for households with families. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.

Sentence (English): If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. It is easy to fit plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, pots, and pans all at once, so I think it is a product that is especially well-suited for households with families. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.

Sentence (English): Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. It is easy to fit plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, pots, and pans all at once, so I think it is a product that is especially well-suited for households with families. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. While upgrading my kitchen appliances, I purchased the Samsung Infinite AI Built-in Dishwasher in Satin White (14-place setting). At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but after using it for a few days, I understood why people say it's hard to go back to hand washing once you've used one. The most satisfying aspect was the cleaning power. I no longer have to wash dishes by hand immediately after meals, and even greasy plates, cups, and cutlery are cleaned surprisingly thoroughly. I found the AI Custom Wash function particularly convenient, as it automatically adjusts based on the level of soiling. The fact that I didn't have to meticulously select specific cycles every time was a significant advantage in actual use. Being a 14-place setting model, the interior space is ample. It is easy to fit plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, pots, and pans all at once, so I think it is a product that is especially well-suited for households with families. The shelf structure is well-designed, making it easy to load and unload dishes, and I also liked the separate zone for cup washing. It feels like they paid attention even to the inside of the cups, so I think households that frequently use cups will be highly satisfied. The drying function was also better than expected. It is a hassle to have to wipe dishes again if they remain wet after using a dishwasher, but thanks to the hot air drying feature, dishes dry quite thoroughly. While you might be disappointed if you expect plastic containers or cups to dry completely without a drop of water, overall, it requires significantly less effort. The satin white design makes the kitchen look clean and bright. Being a built-in type, it doesn't stand out and blends naturally with the sink, contributing to high satisfaction with the interior. It feels like it not only provides convenience but also helps to tidy up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciate the built-in filter. Since this product washes dishes that come into contact with the mouth, hygiene was a concern, but the filter maintenance function gives me peace of mind. If I had to point out a drawback, it takes a little time to get used to how to arrange dishes efficiently at first. Also, as it is a built-in unit, you need to carefully check the installation environment beforehand. However, satisfaction is much greater once it is installed. Overall, while it is on the pricier side, it is a sufficiently satisfying product in that it reduces the time and effort spent on daily dishwashing. This dishwasher is recommended for those who want to reduce the burden of kitchen work, or for households that frequently generate a lot of dishes after family meals.
